findings.text: 聊天网页用户整理/阅读/导出对话；本轮核本地声明与代表JSON导出链，见 [Q01](#research-q01)。
MV3内容脚本启动Host；本地输入校验/禁用入库、按页面/状态/仲裁挂载原语或DOM；受管释放及语义守卫已接线，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
已核固定材料身份/四摘要；读MV3和后台按权限动态注册、内容Host、弹窗导入到存储与运行、代表原语/JSON下载、语义adapter、DOM/scope/释放/健康。未装目标、跑作者测试，未穷审所有原语/站点/格式、账户隔离/云或商店包；下载动作不等文件落盘验收。
根包2.2.1；浏览器客户端及其本地插件生态，不是DSH bundle，根包版本不等各商店发行或线上站点统一版本。

| 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 首次使用 | 浏览器/构建、上游账号未知 | 安装/授权/备份/样本核查 | 商店成品未运行 |
| 持续使用 | DOM观察/本地数据/可选云未知 | 站点兼容/声明版本/结果复核 | 净节时未测 |
| 失败恢复 | 部分文件/云副本/挂起未知 | 关功能/重载/核原文与已有对象 | 不以健康或成功提示判完成 |
| 退出 | 本地资料/云/下载留存未知 | 导出备份/撤权/卸载与云单独处理 | 未核自动删除闭环 |
从非敏感小对话和少量功能开始，权限/正文/开关恢复不符即关功能并回原生流程，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

| 效果项 | 当前证据支持 | 尚不能确定 |
|---|---|---|
| 日常整理导出 | 工具栏/对话框到JSON下载调用 | 内容完整/磁盘成功/节时 |
| 配置扩展 | 校验/禁用导入/受限原语 | 所有输入与站点可靠 |
| 可恢复运行 | scope/资源等待/属性叠层 | 已有类/外部副作用全恢复 |
| 目标保护 | 已迁移语义键守卫/零命中 | 全键正确和业务结果验收 |
[Q02](#research-q02) 的效果所有权、异步释放与后继等待值得借鉴；[Q03](#research-q03) 分类型原值及语义覆盖的反例应成为验收条件。
受限声明与第一方原语、生命周期清理、独占资源后继等待和选择器语义保护组合，降低散脚本的管理摩擦，效果仍需实际样本，见 [Q02](#research-q02)。
健康计数不是任务正确；属性原值与class owner机制不同，同名已有gv-类可被最终释放移除，不能宣称全保真；云/广域权限另核，见 [Q03](#research-q03)。
相对现有guard/释放增加原有class状态保留，并对固定对话任务记录内容/目标与开关恢复差异，比较错误和总维护成本，见 [Q05](#research-q05)。

| 依赖或条件 | 是否必需 | 用途 | 缺失或不满足时 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 支持的浏览器/正确扩展成品 | 必需 | MV3客户端 | 源码不证明各商店成品一致 |
| 当前网页/站点adapter/获授权限 | 按页面 | 定位目标与动态注入 | 不满足不挂载，页面改变需复核 |
| 本地声明/具体引擎/受限原语 | 自定义时 | 无任意JS的配置扩展 | 校验拒绝或运行条件阻断 |
| 受管scope/效果账本 | 相关功能 | 清理和后继资源等待 | 未登记或失败清理不兜底 |
| 聊天账号/Drive等 | 部分功能 | 上游聊天/可选云同步 | 额外权限/费用/远端副本另核 |

technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 自认借鉴Cordis，novelty25%超单一换皮0%不升50%新范式；校验/页面仲裁/异步释放后继与语义adapter形成活动机制75%超简单mount/cleanup50%，原类反例不足100%；所有权模式跨网页迁移75%高于单站封装50%，仍需场景adapter不足100%；统一UI与声明简化50%超仅文档25%，站点与云依赖阻75%。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 整理与导出连续动作workflow/delivery50%超单按钮25%，无完整用户/文件内容验收阻75%；弹窗低门槛但跨站权限/兼容仍重reach25%阻50%普适扩散；已核机制没有改变服务收费/资源交易组织的economics增量取0%，不把未知节时填0。

recommendation.reason: 经常整理聊天记录且愿意核对网页权限的用户，可先用非敏感小对话试用少量阅读或导出功能。相比书签、复制和分散脚本，源码支持统一配置、受限声明、实际导出入口与受管清理，但健康状态不能证明内容正确，已有同名类也有恢复边界。若目标错位、导出遗漏或停用后页面状态异常，应关闭相应功能，保留原文和开关次序并退回原生导出或手工复制。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 阅读整理导出具体可重复，50%超泛增强25%，没有独立用户频率/需求强度不足75%。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 同一UI/受限声明/释放组合50%超单脚本便利25%，[Q03](#research-q03)恢复与目标结果反证阻75%。

evidence.rationale: 实际入口、原语/下载、导入/运行/释放见[Q01](#research-q01)至[Q03](#research-q03)，源码50%高于README25%，无真实站点/文件验收阻75%，非默认分。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 按需关闭/备份/原生退路50%超过不可管理25%；站点/权限、云副本及清理复核仍需投入，不足75%。

publication.summaries.text: 为聊天网页集成阅读、组织和导出，并通过受限本地声明、目标守卫与生命周期账本管理页面增强功能。

items.界面: 浏览器弹窗/页面工具栏与声明配置
items.事件监听: 按页面和状态更新挂载与受管清理
items.后台: 扩展服务工作线程权限注册和可选云消息

publication.capabilities.table:
| 能力 | 主要用途 | 使用条件与边界 |
|---|---|---|
| 阅读/组织/导出 | 聊天网页资料处理 | 本轮仅代表JSON链，不外推全格式 |
| 本地声明 | 调受限DOM/第一方原语 | 校验入库默认关闭，非任意JS |
| 目标/健康 | 已迁移语义守卫与零命中提示 | 不代表全目标/结果正确 |
| 释放/恢复 | 登记效果/资源后继协调 | 原类及清理错误有边界 |
| 云同步 | 可选远端副本 | 授权/身份/删除另验 |

publication.advice.text: 从非敏感小对话和少量功能开始，权限/正文/开关恢复不符即关功能并回原生流程，见 [Q04](#research-q04)。

Any web UI, including DeepSeek Harness.\" width=\"820\">\n</p>\n\n## How it works\n\nVoyager keeps three things apart.\n\n- **Sites.** One small file per site says where things are on its page: the sidebar, a message, the composer.\n- **Primitives.** Abilities Voyager ships once and runs anywhere: a timeline, folders, formula copy, diagrams, export.\n- **Plugins.** Plain JSON that points primitives and CSS at those places. Nothing in a plugin runs as code, and every change it makes comes off when you turn it off.\n\nSo a site that redesigns its page needs one file fixed, and on ChatGPT, Claude, DeepSeek and Kimi that fix arrives from the plugin catalog without an extension update. A new site is one more file. And a plugin written once runs on every site it names.\n\nThis is the core of a plugin that blurs the sidebar before you take a screenshot, on four sites:\n\n```json\n{\n  \"matches\": [\n    \"https://gemini.google.com/*\",\n    \"https://chatgpt.com/*\",\n    \"https://claude.ai/*\",\n    \"https://chat.deepseek.com/*\"\n  ],\n  \"contributes\": {\n    \"styles\": [{ \"css\": \".gv-shot-blur { filter: blur(6px) }\" }],\n    \"domOps\": [\n      {\n        \"op\": \"addClass\",\n        \"className\": \"gv-shot-blur\",\n        \"target\": { \"kind\": \"semantic\", \"key\": \"sidebar\" }\n      }\n    ]\n  }\n}\n```\n\n`sidebar` is a name, not a selector. Each site's file says what it means there.\n\nVoyager's own features are built the same way. The timeline, formula copy, quote reply, reading width and nearly everything else ship as official plugins on top of the same primitives. Folders on Gemini and AI Studio are the last piece still running as built-in code, and they are moving over too.\n\n## What you get\n\n● works once installed · ○ one switch in the popup\n\n| Feature       "content": "import { isSemanticSelectorKey } from '@/features/plugins/sites/semanticKeys';\nimport type { SiteAdapter } from '@/features/plugins/types';\n\nimport { guardedChatgptSemanticSelector } from './chatgptSemantics';\nimport { guardedComposerSemanticSelector, isComposerSemanticKey } from './composerSemantics';\nimport { getSiteSelectorContract } from './contracts';\nimport { getSiteSelectorView } from './service';\nimport { guardedSiteStructureSelector, isSiteStructureKey } from './siteSemantics';\nimport { getPageSelectorSiteId } from './sites';\nimport type { SiteSelectorView } from './types';\n\n/** ON freezes migrated reads; OFF retains the adapter values used before migration. */\nexport function pageSemanticSelector(\n  adapter: Pick<SiteAdapter, 'id' | 'selectors'>,\n  key: string,\n  doc: Document | undefined = typeof document === 'undefined' ? undefined : document,\n): string | undefined {\n  const contract = getSiteSelectorContract(adapter.id);\n  // Existing catalog semantics outside this migration still belong to the resolved adapter.\n  if (!contract || (isSemanticSelectorKey(key) && !contract.keys.includes(key)))\n    return adapter.selectors[key];\n  const view = getSiteSelectorView(adapter.id);\n  // OFF must retain cached upload owners and other baseline semantic overrides.\n  if (isSemanticSelectorKey(key) && view.semanticSource === 'adapter')\n    return adapter.selectors[key];\n  return doc ? pageSemanticSelectorInView(key, view, doc) : view.profiles[key]?.join(',');\n}\n\n/** The claim is frozen by the operation owner; DOM ownership is proved at each read. */\nexport function pageSemanticSelectorInView(\n  key: string,\n  view: SiteSelectorView,\n  doc: Document,\n): string | undefined {\n  if (isComposerSemanticKey(key) && view.siteId !== 'gemini')\n    return guardedComposerSemanticSelector(key, view, doc);\n  if (isSiteStructureKey(view.siteId, key)) return guardedSiteStructureSelector(key, view, doc);\n  return view.siteId === 'chatgpt'\n    ? guardedChatgptSemanticSelector(key, view, doc)\n    : view.profiles[key]?.join(',');\n}\n\n/** Only the caller's migrated fields change; custom adapters and unrelated theme/data stay intact. */\nexport function withPageSemanticSelectors(\n  adapter: SiteAdapter,\n  keys: readonly string[],\n): SiteAdapter {\n  if (!getSiteSelectorContract(adapter.id)) return adapter;\n  let selectors: Record<string, string> | undefined;\n  for (const key of keys) {\n    const value = pageSemanticSelector(adapter, key);\n    if (value === adapter.selectors[key]) continue;\n    selectors ??= { ...adapter.selectors };\n    if (value === undefined) delete selectors[key];\n    else selectors[key] = value;\n  }\n  return selectors ? { ...adapter, selectors } : adapter;\n}\n\n/** Resolve frozen profiles per read, preserving baseline declarative placement-key overrides. */\nexport function withGuardedPageAdapter(\n  adapter: SiteAdapter | null,\n  doc: Document,\n  purpose: 'native' | 'declarative' = 'native',\n): SiteAdapter | null {\n  if (!adapter || adapter.id === 'gemini' || getPageSelectorSiteId(doc) !== adapter.id)\n    return adapter;\n  const selectors: Record<string, string> = {};\n  for (const key of Object.keys(adapter.selectors)) {\n    Object.defineProperty(selectors, key, {\n      enumerable: true,\n      get: () =>\n        // Declarative ops keep the pre-contract site override trust; native placement still uses Tier B.\n        purpose === 'declarative' && (key === 'sidebar' || key === 'headerActions')\n          ? adapter.selectors[key]\n          : (pageSemanticSelector(adapter, key, doc) ?? ':not(*)'),\n    });\n  }\n  return { ...adapter, selectors };\n}\n\n/** Only remote semantic operations need to re-prove ownership after mounting. */\nexport function hasPageSemanticFixes(\n  adapter: SiteAdapter | null,\n  keys: readonly string[],\n  doc: Document,\n): boolean {\n  if (!adapter || adapter.id !== getPageSelectorSiteId(doc)) return false;\n  const view = getSiteSelectorView(adapter.id);\n  return keys.some((key) => view.remoteKeys.has(key));\n}\n"

      "path": "src/features/export/services/ConversationExportService.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Conversation Export Service\n * Unified service for exporting conversations in multiple formats\n * Uses Strategy pattern for format-specific implementations\n */\nimport { IMAGE_RENDER_EVENT_ERROR_CODE, isEventLikeImageRenderError } from '../types/errors';\nimport { DEFAULT_EXPORT_SPEAKER_LABELS } from '../types/export';\nimport type {\n  ChatTurn,\n  ConversationMetadata,\n  ExportFormat,\n  ExportLayout,\n  ExportOptions,\n  ExportResult,\n} from '../types/export';\nimport { DeepResearchPDFPrintService } from './DeepResearchPDFPrintService';\nimport { ImageExportService } from './ImageExportService';\nimport { MarkdownFormatter } from './MarkdownFormatter';\nimport { PDFPrintService } from './PDFPrintService';\nimport { MAX_EXPORT_IMAGE_TOTAL_BYTES, fetchBoundedExportImage } from './boundedImageFetch';\nimport { packageMarkdownImages } from './markdownImageArchive';\n\n/**\n * Main export service\n * Coordinates different export strategies\n */\nexport class ConversationExportService {\n  private static readonly REPORT_JSON_FORMAT = 'gemini-voyager.report.v1' as const;\n\n  private static readonly CHAT_JSON_FORMAT = 'gemini-voyager.chat.v1' as const;\n\n  private static assertNotAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {\n    if (signal?.aborted) throw new DOMException('Export cancelled', 'AbortError');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Export conversation in specified format\n   */\n  static async export(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    try {\n      this.assertNotAborted(options.signal);\n      const layout: ExportLayout = options.layout ?? 'conversation';\n      if (layout === 'document') {\n        return await this.exportDocument(turns, metadata, options);\n      }\n\n      const conversationOptions: ExportOptions = {\n        ...options,\n        speakerLabels: options.speakerLabels ?? DEFAULT_EXPORT_SPEAKER_LABELS,\n      };\n\n      switch (conversationOptions.format) {\n        case 'json':\n          return this.exportJSON(turns, metadata, conversationOptions);\n\n        case 'markdown':\n          return await this.exportMarkdown(turns, metadata, conversationOptions);\n\n        case 'pdf':\n          return await this.exportPDF(turns, metadata, conversationOptions);\n\n        case 'image':\n          return await this.exportImage(turns, metadata, conversationOptions);\n\n        default:\n          return {\n            success: false,\n            format: options.format,\n            error: `Unsupported format: ${options.format}`,\n          };\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      return {\n        success: false,\n        format: options.format,\n        error: this.normalizeError(error),\n      };\n    }\n  }\n\n  private static normalizeError(error: unknown): string {\n    if (error instanceof DOMException) {\n      return error.message;\n    }\n    if (error instanceof Error) {\n      return error.message;\n    }\n\n    if (typeof Event !== 'undefined' && error instanceof Event) {\n      return IMAGE_RENDER_EVENT_ERROR_CODE;\n    }\n\n    if (isEventLikeImageRenderError(error)) {\n      return IMAGE_RENDER_EVENT_ERROR_CODE;\n    }\n\n    return String(error);\n  }\n\n  private static async exportDocument(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    const content = this.extractDocumentContent(turns);\n\n    switch (options.format) {\n      case 'json':\n        return this.exportDocumentJSON(content, metadata, options);\n      case 'markdown':\n        return await this.exportDocumentMarkdown(content, metadata, options);\n      case 'pdf':\n        return await this.exportDocumentPDF(content, metadata, options);\n      case 'image':\n        return await this.exportDocumentImage(content, metadata, options);\n      default:\n        return {\n          success: false,\n          format: options.format,\n          error: `Unsupported format: ${options.format}`,\n        };\n    }\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Export as JSON, with the same Markdown-formatted content as the Markdown export.\n   */\n  private static exportJSON(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): ExportResult {\n    const processedItems = turns.map((turn) => {\n      const attachments = turn.userContent\n        ? turn.userContent.attachments\n        : (turn.attachments ?? []);\n      return {\n        user: turn.userContent?.text || turn.user,\n        assistant: turn.assistantContent?.text || turn.assistant,\n        starred: turn.starred,\n        ...(attachments.length > 0 ? { attachments } : {}),\n      };\n    });\n\n    const payload = {\n      format: this.CHAT_JSON_FORMAT,\n      url: metadata.url,\n      exportedAt: metadata.exportedAt,\n      count: metadata.count,\n      title: metadata.title,\n      items: processedItems,\n    };\n\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('json', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    this.assertNotAborted(options.signal);\n    this.downloadJSON(payload, filename);\n\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'json' as ExportFormat,\n      filename,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Export as Markdown\n   */\n  private static async exportMarkdown(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    // First create a clean markdown (no inlining)\n    let markdown = MarkdownFormatter.format(turns, metadata, {\n      usePromptAsTurnHeading: options.usePromptAsTurnHeading,\n      speakerLabels: options.speakerLabels,\n    });\n\n    // Strip image source attribution lines if user opted out\n    if (options.includeImageSource === false) {\n      markdown = markdown.replace(/\\n\\*Source: \\[[^\\]]*\\]\\([^)]*\\)\\*\\n/g, '\\n');\n    }\n\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('md', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    const archived = await this.downloadMarkdownOrZip(\n      markdown,\n      filename,\n      'chat.md',\n      options.signal,\n    );\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'markdown' as ExportFormat,\n      filename: archived.filename,\n      omittedImageCount: archived.omittedImageCount,\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Export as PDF (using print dialog)\n   */\n  private static async exportPDF(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    await PDFPrintService.export(turns, metadata, {\n      fontSize: options.fontSize,\n      speakerLabels: options.speakerLabels,\n      signal: options.signal,\n    });\n\n    // Note: We can't get the actual filename from print dialog\n    // User chooses filename in Save as PDF dialog\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'pdf' as ExportFormat,\n      filename: options.filename || this.generateFilename('pdf', metadata.title, metadata.platform),\n    };\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Export as image (PNG)\n   */\n  private static async exportImage(\n    turns: ChatTurn[],\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('png', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    await ImageExportService.export(turns, metadata, {\n      filename,\n      fontSize: options.fontSize,\n      imageWidth: options.imageWidth,\n      speakerLabels: options.speakerLabels,\n      signal: options.signal,\n    });\n    return { success: true, format: 'image' as ExportFormat, filename };\n  }\n\n  private static exportDocumentJSON(\n    content: { markdown: string; html: string },\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): ExportResult {\n    const payload = {\n      format: this.REPORT_JSON_FORMAT,\n      url: metadata.url,\n      exportedAt: metadata.exportedAt,\n      title: metadata.title,\n      content: {\n        markdown: content.markdown,\n        html: content.html,\n      },\n    };\n\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('json', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    this.assertNotAborted(options.signal);\n    this.downloadJSON(payload, filename);\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'json' as ExportFormat,\n      filename,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private static async exportDocumentMarkdown(\n    content: { markdown: string; html: string },\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    const markdown = this.composeDocumentMarkdown(content.markdown, metadata);\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('md', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    const mdEntryName = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md')\n      ? filename.split('/').pop() || 'report.md'\n      : 'report.md';\n\n    const archived = await this.downloadMarkdownOrZip(\n      markdown,\n      filename,\n      mdEntryName,\n      options.signal,\n    );\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'markdown' as ExportFormat,\n      filename: archived.filename,\n      omittedImageCount: archived.omittedImageCount,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private static async exportDocumentPDF(\n    content: { markdown: string; html: string },\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    await DeepResearchPDFPrintService.export(\n      {\n        title: metadata.title || 'Deep Research Report',\n        url: metadata.url,\n        exportedAt: metadata.exportedAt,\n        markdown: content.markdown,\n        html: content.html,\n      },\n      { fontSize: options.fontSize },\n    );\n\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'pdf' as ExportFormat,\n      filename: options.filename || this.generateFilename('pdf', metadata.title, metadata.platform),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private static async exportDocumentImage(\n    content: { markdown: string; html: string },\n    metadata: ConversationMetadata,\n    options: ExportOptions,\n  ): Promise<ExportResult> {\n    const filename =\n      options.filename || this.generateFilename('png', metadata.title, metadata.platform);\n    await ImageExportService.exportDocument(\n      {\n        title: metadata.title || 'Deep Research Report',\n        url: metadata.url,\n        exportedAt: metadata.exportedAt,\n        markdown: content.markdown,\n        html: content.html,\n      },\n      {\n        filename,\n        fontSize: options.fontSize,\n        imageWidth: options.imageWidth,\n        signal: options.signal,\n      },\n    );\n\n    return {\n      success: true,\n      format: 'image' as ExportFormat,\n      filename,\n    };\n  }\n\n  private static extractDocumentContent(turns: ChatTurn[]): { markdown: string; html: string } {\n    const turn =\n      turns.find((item) => item.assistantContent || item.assistant.trim()) ||\n      turns.find((item) => item.userContent || item.user.trim());\n\n    if (!turn) {\n      return { markdown: '', html: '' };\n    }\n\n    if (turn.assistantContent) {\n      const extracted = turn.assistantContent;\n      return {\n        markdown: extracted.text || turn.assistant,\n        html: extracted.html || this.formatPlainTextAsHtml(extracted.text || turn.assistant),\n      };\n    }\n\n    if (turn.userContent) {\n      const extracted = turn.userContent;\n      return {\n        markdown: extracted.text || turn.user,\n        html: extracted.html || this.formatPlainTextAsHtml(extracted.text || turn.user),\n      };\n    }\n\n    const markdown = turn.assistant || turn.user || '';\n    return {\n      markdown,\n      html: this.formatPlainTextAsHtml(markdown),\n    };\n  }\n\n  private static composeDocumentMarkdown(content: string, metadata: ConversationMetadata): string {\n    const sections: string[] = [];\n    const title = metadata.title?.trim() || 'Deep Research Report';\n    const trimmedContent = content.trim() || '_No content_';\n    const startsWithHeading = this.hasLeadingMarkdownHeading(trimmedContent);\n\n    if (!startsWithHeading) {\n      sections.push(`# ${title}`);\n      sections.push('');\n    }\n\n    sections.push(trimmedContent);\n    sections.push('');\n    sections.push('---');\n    sections.push('');\n    sections.push(`Source: ${metadata.url}`);\n    sections.push(`Exported at: ${metadata.exportedAt}`);\n    return sections.join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  private static hasLeadingMarkdownHeading(content: string): boolean {\n    return /^#{1,6}\\s+\\S/m.test(content) && /^#{1,6}\\s+\\S/.test(content);\n  }\n\n  private static formatPlainTextAsHtml(content: string): string {\n    if (!content.trim()) return '';\n    const escaped = content.replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>');\n    return escaped\n      .split('\\n\\n')\n      .map((paragraph) => `<p>${paragraph.replace(/\\n/g, '<br>')}</p>`)\n      .join('\\n');\n  }\n\n  private static async downloadMarkdownOrZip(\n    markdown: string,\n    filename: string,\n    markdownEntryName: string,\n    signal?: AbortSignal,\n  ): Promise<{ filename: string; omittedImageCount: number }> {\n    this.assertNotAborted(signal);\n    const normalizedFilename = filename.toLowerCase().endsWith('.md') ? filename : `${filename}.md`;\n    if (MarkdownFormatter.extractImageUrls(markdown).length === 0) {\n      MarkdownFormatter.download(markdown, normalizedFilename);\n      return { filename: normalizedFilename, omittedImageCount: 0 };\n    }\n\n    return await packageMarkdownImages({\n      markdown,\n      normalizedFilename,\n      markdownEntryName,\n      signal,\n      fetchImage: (url, budget, fetchSignal) =>\n        this.fetchImageForMarkdownPackaging(url, budget, fetchSignal),\n      toOriginalSizeUrl: (url) => this.toOriginalSizeUrl(url),\n      pickExtension: (contentType, url) => this.pickImageExtension(contentType, url),\n    });\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Replace Google image URL size parameter with =s0 for original resolution.\n   * Non-Google URLs are returned unchanged.\n   */\n  private static toOriginalSizeUrl(url: string): string {\n    const isGoogle = url.includes('googleusercontent.com') || url.includes('ggpht.com');\n    if (!isGoogle) return url;\n    const GOOGLE_SIZE_PATTERN = /=[swh]\\d+[^?#]*/;\n    if (GOOGLE_SIZE_PATTERN.test(url)) {\n      return url.replace(GOOGLE_SIZE_PATTERN, '=s0');\n    }\n    if (url.includes('?')) {\n      const parsed = new URL(url);\n      parsed.searchParams.set('s', '0');\n      return parsed.toString();\n    }\n    return url.split(/[?#]/, 1)[0].includes('=') ? url + '-s0' : url + '=s0';\n  }\n\n  private static pickImageExtension(contentType: string | null, url: string): string {\n    const byType: Record<string, string> = {\n      'image/png': 'png',\n      'image/jpeg': 'jpg',\n      'image/jpg': 'jpg',\n      'image/webp': 'webp',\n      'image/gif': 'gif',\n      'image/svg+xml': 'svg',\n    };\n    if (contentType && byType[contentType]) return byType[contentType];\n    const match = url.split('?')[0].match(/\\.(png|jpg|jpeg|gif|webp|svg)$/i);\n    if (match) return match[1].toLowerCase() === 'jpeg' ? 'jpg' : match[1].toLowerCase();\n    return 'bin';\n  }\n\n  private static async fetchImageForMarkdownPackaging(\n    url: string,\n    budget = { remainingBytes: MAX_EXPORT_IMAGE_TOTAL_BYTES },\n    signal?: AbortSignal,\n  ): Promise<{ blob: Blob; contentType: string | null } | null> {\n    return await fetchBoundedExportImage(url, budget, signal);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Download JSON file\n   */\n  private static downloadJSON(data: unknown, filename: string): void {\n    const blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(data, null, 2)], {\n      type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8',\n    });\n    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n    const a = document.createElement('a');\n    a.href = url;\n    a.download = filename;\n    document.body.appendChild(a);\n    a.click();\n    setTimeout(() => {\n      try {\n        document.body.removeChild(a);\n      } catch {\n        /* ignore */\n      }\n      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n    }, 0);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Generate filename with timestamp\n   */\n  private static generateFilename(extension: string, title?: string, platform?: string): string {\n    const titlePart = this.sanitizeFilenamePart(title);\n    if (titlePart) {\n      return `${titlePart}.${extension}`;\n    }\n\n    const slug = (platform || 'gemini').toLowerCase().replace(/\\s+/g, '-');\n    const pad = (n: number) => String(n).padStart(2, '0');\n    const d = new Date();\n    const y = d.getFullYear();\n    const m = pad(d.getMonth() + 1);\n    const day = pad(d.getDate());\n    const hh = pad(d.getHours());\n    const mm = pad(d.getMinutes());\n    const ss = pad(d.getSeconds());\n    return `${slug}-chat-${y}${m}${day}-${hh}${mm}${ss}.${extension}`;\n  }\n\n  private static sanitizeFilenamePart(title?: string): string {\n    if (!title) return '';\n\n    const compact = title.trim().replace(/\\s+/g, ' ');\n    if (!compact) return '';\n\n    return compact\n      .replace(/[\\\\/:*?\"<>|]/g, '')\n      .replace(/\\s+/g, '-')\n      .replace(/\\.+$/g, '')\n      .slice(0, 80);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Get available export formats\n   */\n  static getAvailableFormats(): Array<{\n    format: ExportFormat;\n    label: string;\n    description: string;\n    recommended?: boolean;\n  }> {\n    return [\n      {\n        format: 'json' as ExportFormat,\n        label: 'JSON',\n        description: 'Machine-readable format for developers',\n      },\n      {\n        format: 'markdown' as ExportFormat,\n        label: 'Markdown',\n        description: 'Clean, portable text format (recommended)',\n        recommended: true,\n      },\n      {\n        format: 'pdf' as ExportFormat,\n        label: 'PDF',\n        description: 'Print-friendly format via Save as PDF',\n      },\n      {\n        format: 'image' as ExportFormat,\n        label: 'Image',\n        description: 'Single PNG image for sharing',\n      },\n    ];\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "src/features/plugins/local/LocalPluginSource.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * LocalPluginSource — plugins the user imported from the popup (`kind: 'local'`).\n *\n * Reads `localPluginStore` and passes every record through the same\n * `validateLocalManifest` gate the importer used, so stored data is never\n * trusted: a record a newer build would reject is skipped and logged. The one\n * check deferred is the packaged host policy: a record that only this build's\n * site policy refuses stays listed, and `PluginHost` reports it as\n * `blocked: host-policy` instead of the user's plugin silently vanishing. Merged\n * last by `mergePluginRecords`, under the `local.*` ids no other source may use,\n * and exempt from the remote kill switch.\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\n\nimport type { PluginManifest, PluginSource } from '../types';\nimport { LOCAL_PLUGIN_SOURCE_ID } from './localPluginId';\nimport { type LocalPluginRecordMap, loadLocalPluginRecords } from './localPluginStore';\nimport { validateLocalManifest } from './validateLocalManifest';\n\nexport interface LocalPluginSourceOptions {\n  /** Injectable for tests; defaults to the storage-backed store. */\n  readonly loadRecords?: () => Promise<LocalPluginRecordMap>;\n}\n\nexport class LocalPluginSource implements PluginSource {\n  readonly id = LOCAL_PLUGIN_SOURCE_ID;\n  readonly kind = 'local' as const;\n  private readonly loadRecords: () => Promise<LocalPluginRecordMap>;\n\n  constructor(options: LocalPluginSourceOptions = {}) {\n    this.loadRecords = options.loadRecords ?? loadLocalPluginRecords;\n  }\n\n  async list(): Promise<readonly PluginManifest[]> {\n    const manifests: PluginManifest[] = [];\n    for (const [id, record] of Object.entries(await this.loadRecords())) {\n      const result = validateLocalManifest(record.manifest, undefined, { hostPolicy: 'defer' });\n      if (result.success && result.data.manifest.id === id) {\n        manifests.push(result.data.manifest);\n      } else {\n        logger.warn('Skipping invalid local plugin', {\n          id,\n          issues: result.success\n            ? [{ path: 'id', message: 'does not match its key' }]\n            : result.error,\n        });\n      }\n    }\n    return manifests;\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "src/features/plugins/local/localPluginImport.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Import, re-import, export and removal of user-authored plugins. The popup\n * calls these; nothing here touches the DOM.\n *\n * Import is validate-then-swap: the manifest passes `validateLocalManifest`\n * before anything is written, so a failed re-import leaves the installed\n * version untouched and returns every issue (path + message) for the user.\n * A successful import is written in one storage write together with its\n * disabled state (`saveLocalPluginRecord`), so it always lands DISABLED: the\n * popup may close at any moment, and a stale `enabled: true` entry (for\n * example restored from Drive, or the previous version's) must never switch on\n * code the user has not inspected yet. A failed write reports the failure.\n */\nimport type { ManifestIssue } from '../manifest/validate';\nimport type { PluginManifest } from '../types';\nimport { type LocalPluginFile, readLocalPluginFiles } from './localPluginFiles';\nimport { toLocalPluginId } from './localPluginId';\nimport {\n  LocalPluginChangedError,\n  type LocalPluginRecord,\n  type LocalPluginRecordMap,\n  loadLocalPluginRecords,\n  removeLocalPluginRecord,\n  saveLocalPluginRecord,\n} from './localPluginStore';\nimport { validateLocalManifest } from './validateLocalManifest';\n\n// The file read moved to `localPluginFiles.ts` (no storage, so the CLI can use it).\nexport {\n  type LocalPluginFile,\n  MAX_LOCAL_PLUGIN_IMPORT_CHARS,\n  MAX_LOCAL_PLUGIN_STYLES,\n  readLocalPluginFiles,\n} from './localPluginFiles';\n\nfunction issue(path: string, message: string): ManifestIssue {\n  return { path, message };\n}\n\nexport type LocalPluginImportResult =\n  | { readonly ok: true; readonly manifest: PluginManifest; readonly previousVersion?: string }\n  | {\n      readonly ok: false;\n      readonly issues: readonly ManifestIssue[];\n      /** Version still installed under the same id; a failed import never replaces it. */\n      readonly previousVersion?: string;\n      /** The install changed after the user reviewed it; review again before importing. */\n      readonly changedSinceReview?: true;\n    };\n\nexport interface LocalPluginImportDeps {\n  readonly loadRecords: () => Promise<LocalPluginRecordMap>;\n  /**\n   * Store the manifest and switch the plugin off in one write; reject on any\n   * failure, and with `LocalPluginChangedError` when `expectedInstalled` is\n   * given and the install under the id is no longer that one.\n   */\n  readonly installDisabled: (\n    manifest: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,\n    expectedInstalled?: string | null,\n  ) => Promise<void>;\n}\n\nconst DEFAULT_DEPS: LocalPluginImportDeps = {\n  loadRecords: loadLocalPluginRecords,\n  installDisabled: (manifest, expectedInstalled) =>\n    saveLocalPluginRecord(\n      manifest,\n      Date.now(),\n      expectedInstalled === undefined ? {} : { expectedInstalled },\n    ),\n};\n\nexport interface LocalPluginImportOptions {\n  /**\n   * `localPluginRecordSnapshot` of what was installed under the id when the\n   * user reviewed this manifest (the AI-reply preview). The import then lands\n   * only over that exact install; anything else returns `changedSinceReview`.\n   */\n  readonly expectedInstalled?: string | null;\n}\n\nfunction recordVersion(record: LocalPluginRecord | undefined): string | undefined {\n  return typeof record?.manifest.version === 'string' ? record.manifest.version : undefined;\n}\n\n/** Validate a raw manifest and, only when it passes, install it disabled. */\nexport async function importLocalPlugin(\n  raw: unknown,\n  deps: LocalPluginImportDeps = DEFAULT_DEPS,\n  options: LocalPluginImportOptions = {},\n): Promise<LocalPluginImportResult> {\n  const rawId =\n    typeof raw === 'object' && raw !== null && 'id' in raw && typeof raw.id === 'string'\n      ? toLocalPluginId(raw.id)\n      : null;\n  const records = await deps.loadRecords();\n  const previousVersion = rawId ? recordVersion(records[rawId]) : undefined;\n  const previous = previousVersion ? { previousVersion } : {};\n\n  const result = validateLocalManifest(raw);\n  if (!result.success) return { ok: false, issues: result.error, ...previous };\n\n  const { manifest } = result.data;\n  try {\n    await deps.installDisabled(result.data.raw, options.expectedInstalled);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (error instanceof LocalPluginChangedError) {\n      const current = recordVersion((await deps.loadRecords())[manifest.id]);\n      return {\n        ok: false,\n        issues: [issue('', error.message)],\n        changedSinceReview: true,\n        ...(current ? { previousVersion: current } : {}),\n      };\n    }\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      issues: [issue('', error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error))],\n      ...previous,\n    };\n  }\n  return { ok: true, manifest, ...previous };\n}\n\n/** Read picked files (or pasted text as one `plugin.json`) and import the result. */\nexport async function importLocalPluginFiles(\n  files: readonly LocalPluginFile[],\n  deps: LocalPluginImportDeps = DEFAULT_DEPS,\n): Promise<LocalPluginImportResult> {\n  const read = await readLocalPluginFiles(files);\n  if (!read.success) return { ok: false, issues: read.error };\n  return importLocalPlugin(read.data, deps);\n}\n\n/** Remove a local plugin together with its enable state and settings. */\nexport async function removeLocalPlugin(id: string): Promise<void> {\n  await removeLocalPluginRecord(id);\n}\n\n/** The stored manifest as a re-importable `plugin.json` (CSS inlined). */\nexport function exportLocalPluginJson(record: LocalPluginRecord): string {\n  return `${JSON.stringify(record.manifest, null, 2)}\\n`;\n}\n"

      "path": "src/features/plugins/local/localPluginRules.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Rules only local plugins follow, on top of the shared manifest gate. Each one\n * turns a manifest that would import and then do nothing (or less than its\n * author expects) into an import error the author can act on:\n *\n *   - `addClass` adds one `gv-` prefixed class (the content-script rule every\n *     injected class follows), so a plugin cannot restyle the page through the\n *     host's own class names;\n *   - every semantic key the plugin relies on is declared by every site it\n *     targets; otherwise the popup would only show it as `needs-semantic`;\n *   - likewise every `site.json` section its primitives read (`needs-site-data`);\n *   - settings are the kinds the popup can render (boolean, number, select): a\n *     string or color setting would import with no control to change it.\n */\nimport type { ManifestIssue } from '../manifest/validate';\nimport { missingSiteSections, requiredSemanticKeys } from '../runtime/pluginStatus';\nimport { patternWithinAny } from '../sites/matchPattern';\nimport { SEMANTIC_SELECTOR_KEYS, isSemanticSelectorKey } from '../sites/semanticKeys';\nimport type { PluginManifest, SiteAdapter } from '../types';\nimport {\n  getNativeOpParamSemanticKeys,\n  getPrimitiveSemanticKeys,\n} from './authoring/primitiveReference';\n\n/** Classes a local plugin adds: one class token that starts with `gv-`. */\nexport const LOCAL_CLASS_NAME_PATTERN = /^gv-[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$/;\n\n/** Setting types the popup renders a control for; the rest are refused on import. */\nexport const LOCAL_SETTING_TYPES = ['boolean', 'number', 'select'] as const;\n\n/** Sites whose `matches` contain at least one of the manifest's patterns. */\nexport function targetedSites(\n  manifest: Pick<PluginManifest, 'matches'>,\n  sites: readonly SiteAdapter[],\n): readonly SiteAdapter[] {\n  return sites.filter((site) =>\n    manifest.matches.some((pattern) => patternWithinAny(pattern, site.matches)),\n  );\n}\n\nfunction classNameIssues(manifest: PluginManifest): ManifestIssue[] {\n  const issues: ManifestIssue[] = [];\n  (manifest.contributes.domOps ?? []).forEach((op, index) => {\n    if (op.op !== 'addClass' || LOCAL_CLASS_NAME_PATTERN.test(op.className)) return;\n    issues.push({\n      path: `contributes.domOps[${index}].className`,\n      message: `\"${op.className}\" must be one class name starting with \"gv-\" (for example \"gv-plugin-my-change\")`,\n    });\n  });\n  return issues;\n}\n\nfunction settingTypeIssues(manifest: PluginManifest): ManifestIssue[] {\n  const allowed: readonly string[] = LOCAL_SETTING_TYPES;\n  return Object.entries(manifest.contributes.settings ?? {}).flatMap(([key, field]) =>\n    allowed.includes(field.type)\n      ? []\n      : [\n          {\n            path: `contributes.settings.${key}.type`,\n            message: `\"${field.type}\" settings have no control in the popup yet: use ${LOCAL_SETTING_TYPES.join(', ')}`,\n          },\n        ],\n  );\n}\n\n/** Why `key` cannot be relied on across these sites, or null when every one declares it. */\nfunction semanticKeyProblem(key: string, sites: readonly SiteAdapter[]): string | null {\n  if (!isSemanticSelectorKey(key)) {\n    return `\"${key}\" is not a semantic key (the vocabulary is ${SEMANTIC_SELECTOR_KEYS.join(', ')})`;\n  }\n  const missing = sites.find((site) => typeof site.selectors[key] !== 'string');\n  if (!missing) return null;\n  const declared = SEMANTIC_SELECTOR_KEYS.filter((k) => typeof missing.selectors[k] === 'string');\n  return `${missing.label} does not declare semantic key \"${key}\" (it declares ${declared.join(', ') || 'none'})`;\n}\n\nfunction semanticIssues(manifest: PluginManifest, sites: readonly SiteAdapter[]): ManifestIssue[] {\n  const targeted = targetedSites(manifest, sites);\n  const issues: ManifestIssue[] = [];\n  const reported = new Set<string>();\n  const report = (path: string, key: string, suffix = ''): void => {\n    const problem = semanticKeyProblem(key, targeted);\n    if (!problem) return;\n    reported.add(key);\n    issues.push({ path, message: `${problem}${suffix}` });\n  };\n  (manifest.contributes.domOps ??       "path": "src/features/plugins/local/localPluginStore.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Storage for user-imported plugins, in `chrome.storage.local` under\n * `StorageKeys.PLUGIN_LOCAL_MANIFESTS` as `Record<'local.<id>', LocalPluginRecord>`.\n *\n * A record keeps the manifest exactly as imported (CSS inlined, id already\n * namespaced). It is NOT trusted on the way out: `LocalPluginSource` passes it\n * through `validateLocalManifest` on every read, so a stricter guard in a later\n * build also covers plugins imported before it.\n *\n * Content scripts read this directly per the content-script storage rule.\n *\n * Mutations (popup only) are whole-map read-modify-writes, so three rules\n * keep them from losing data:\n *   - a failed read rejects the mutation instead of writing back a map built\n *     from `{}` (which would delete every other plugin);\n *   - entries this build cannot read are written back untouched;\n *   - every mutation holds the plugin-storage lock (`pluginStorageLock.ts`),\n *     shared with every plugin-state writer, so two popups, an import racing a\n *     remove, or a late setting toggle run one after the other instead of\n *     overwriting each other.\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\nimport { StorageKeys } from '@/core/types/common';\nimport { isExtensionContextInvalidatedError } from '@/core/utils/extensionContext';\n\nimport {\n  type PluginStateEntry,\n  readPluginStateStrict,\n  withPluginDisabled,\n  withPluginEnabled,\n} from '../storage/pluginState';\nimport { withPluginStorageLock } from '../storage/pluginStorageLock';\nimport type { PluginManifest } from '../types';\nimport { isLocalPluginId } from './localPluginId';\nimport { validateLocalManifest } from './validateLocalManifest';\n\nexport interface LocalPluginRecord {\n  /** Raw manifest as imported, CSS inlined; validated again on every read. */\n  readonly manifest: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;\n  readonly importedAt: number;\n  readonly updatedAt: number;\n}\nexport type LocalPluginRecordMap = Readonly<Record<string, LocalPluginRecord>>;\n\n/** Upper bound on stored local plugins; protects storage and every page load. */\nexport const MAX_LOCAL_PLUGINS = 50;\n\nconst KEY = StorageKeys.PLUGIN_LOCAL_MANIFESTS;\nfunction localArea(): chrome.storage.LocalStorageArea | undefined {\n  const g = globalThis as { chrome?: typeof chrome };\n  return g.chrome?.storage?.local;\n}\n\nfunction isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {\n  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n}\n\nfunction finiteOr(value: unknown, fallback: number): number {\n  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : fallback;\n}\n\n/** Keep well-formed `local.*` entries only; never trust the stored shape. */\nexport function sanitizeLocalPluginRecords(value: unknown): LocalPluginRecordMap {\n  if (!isRecord(value)) return {};\n  const records: Record<string, LocalPluginRecord> = {};\n  for (const [id, entry] of Object.entries(value)) {\n    if (!isLocalPluginId(id) || !isRecord(entry) || !isRecord(entry.manifest)) continue;\n    if (entry.manifest.id !== id) continue;\n    const importedAt = finiteOr(entry.importedAt, 0);\n    records[id] = {\n      manifest: entry.manifest,\n      importedAt,\n      updatedAt: finiteOr(entry.updatedAt, importedAt),\n    };\n    if (Object.keys(records).length >= MAX_LOCAL_PLUGINS) break;\n  }\n  return records;\n}\n\n/** The stored map as-is (unknown entries included); a failed read throws. */\nasync function readStoredMapStrict(\n  local: chrome.storage.LocalStorageArea,\n): Promise<Record<string, unknown>> {\n  const result = await local.get({ [KEY]: {} });\n  const value: unknown = result?.[KEY];\n  return isRecord(value) ? value : {};\n}\n\nexport async function loadLocalPluginRecords(): Promise<LocalPluginRecordMap> {\n  const local = localArea();\n  if (!local) return {};\n  try {\n    const result = await local.get({ [KEY]: {} });\n    return sanitizeLocalPluginRecords(result?.[KEY]);\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (!isExtensionContextInvalidatedError(error)) {\n      logger.warn('loadLocalPluginRecords failed', { error: String(error) });\n    }\n    return {};\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * What a review saw installed under one id: null when nothing was, else the\n * stored record exactly (content and update time), so any import, edit or\n * removal since then reads as a change.\n */\nexport function localPluginRecordSnapshot(record: LocalPluginRecord | undefined): string | null {\n  return record ? JSON.stringify([record.updatedAt, record.manifest]) : null;\n}\n\n/** The install under an id is no longer the one the user reviewed; nothing was written. */\nexport class LocalPluginChangedError extends Error {\n  constructor(id: string) {\n    super(`${id} changed since it was reviewed`);\n    this.name = 'LocalPluginChangedError';\n  }\n}\n\nexport interface SaveLocalPluginOptions {\n  /**\n   * `localPluginRecordSnapshot` of the install the user reviewed. When given,\n   * the save happens only while the install is still exactly that one, checked\n   * under the storage lock; otherwise it rejects with `LocalPluginChangedError`.\n   */\n  readonly expectedInstalled?: string | null;\n}\n\n/**\n * Store a VALIDATED manifest under its (namespaced) id, replacing any previous\n * version, and switch the plugin off in the SAME storage write. One write means\n * no observer (a page's PluginHost, another popup) can ever see the new\n * version under an old `enabled: true`, and a popup closed mid-import leaves\n * either the old state or the new disabled one. Callers validate first: a\n * failed import never reaches this, so the previous version stays in place.\n * Rejects, writing nothing, when either read or the write fails.\n */\nexport async function saveLocalPluginRecord(\n  manifest: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>,\n  now: number = Date.now(),\n  options: SaveLocalPluginOptions = {},\n): Promise<void> {\n  const id = manifest.id;\n  if (typeof id !== 'string' || !isLocalPluginId(id)) {\n    throw new Error('local plugin id must be namespaced under local.');\n  }\n  const local = localArea();\n  if (!local) throw new Error('extension storage is unavailable');\n  await withPluginStorageLock(async () => {\n    const stored = await readStoredMapStrict(local);\n    const state = await readPluginStateStrict(local);\n    const current = sanitizeLocalPluginRecords(stored);\n    const previous = current[id];\n    if (\n      options.expectedInstalled !== undefined &&\n      localPluginRecordSnapshot(previous) !== options.expectedInstalled\n    ) {\n      throw new LocalPluginChangedError(id);\n    }\n    if (!previous && Object.keys(current).length >= MAX_LOCAL_PLUGINS) {\n      throw new Error(`at most ${MAX_LOCAL_PLUGINS} local plugins can be installed`);\n    }\n    const record: LocalPluginRecord = {\n      manifest,\n      importedAt: previous?.importedAt ?? now,\n      updatedAt: now,\n    };\n    await local.set({\n      [KEY]: { ...stored, [id]: record },\n      [StorageKeys.PLUGINS_STATE]: withPluginDisabled(state, id, now),\n    });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Delete one record together with its enable state and settings, in one write\n * so no toggle can slip in between. Rejects, writing nothing, when a read or\n * the write fails.\n */\nexport async function removeLocalPluginRecord(id: string): Promise<void> {\n  const local = localArea();\n  if (!local) return;\n  await withPluginStorageLock(async () => {\n    const stored = await readStoredMapStrict(local);\n    const state = await readPluginStateStrict(local);\n    if (!Object.hasOwn(stored, id) && !Object.hasOwn(state, id)) return;\n    const next: Record<string, unknown> = { ...stored };\n    delete next[id];\n    const nextState: Record<string, PluginStateEntry> = { ...state };\n    delete nextState[id];\n    await local.set({ [KEY]: next, [StorageKeys.PLUGINS_STATE]: nextState });\n  });\n}\n\n/**\n * Switch a local plugin on only while its stored content is exactly the\n * manifest the user reviewed (`seen`, as `LocalPluginSource` listed it). A\n * re-import in another popup between that review and this write publishes the\n * new content disabled; an enable started before it must not switch the new\n * content on, and a version check would miss a same-version edit. `changed`\n * when the content changed or is gone; `write_failed` when storage could not\n * be read or written. Neither writes anything.\n */\nexport type LocalPluginEnableResult = 'enabled' | 'changed' | 'write_failed';\n\nexport async function enableLocalPluginIfUnchanged(\n  seen: PluginManifest,\n  now: number = Date.now(),\n): Promise<LocalPluginEnableResult> {\n  const local = localArea();\n  if (!local) return 'write_failed';\n  try {\n    return await withPluginStorageLock(async () => {\n      const record = sanitizeLocalPluginRecords(await readStoredMapStrict(local))[seen.id];\n      // Read the way `LocalPluginSource` listed `seen`, host policy deferred.\n      const current = record\n        ? validateLocalManifest(record.manifest, undefined, { hostPolicy: 'defer' })\n        : null;\n      if (!current?.success || JSON.stringify(current.data.manifest) !== JSON.stringify(seen)) {\n        logger.warn('Local plugin changed since it was reviewed; not enabling', { id: seen.id });\n        return 'changed';\n      }\n      const state = await readPluginStateStrict(local);\n      await local.set({\n        [StorageKeys.PLUGINS_STATE]: withPluginEnabled(state, seen.id, true, now),\n      });\n      return 'enabled';\n    });\n  } catch (error) {\n    if (!isExtensionContextInvalidatedError(error)) {\n      logger.warn('enableLocalPluginIfUnchanged failed', { id: seen.id, error: String(error) });\n    }\n    return 'write_failed';\n  }\n}\n\n/** Subscribe to imports, updates and removals of local plugins. */\nexport function subscribeLocalPlugins(callback: () => void): () => void {\n  const g = globalThis as { chrome?: typeof chrome };\n  const onChanged = g.chrome?.storage?.onChanged;\n  if (!onChanged) return () => {};\n  const listener = (changes: Record<string, chrome.storage.StorageChange>, area: string): void => {\n    if (area === 'local' && changes[KEY]) callback();\n  };\n  onChanged.addListener(listener);\n  return () => {\n    try {\n      onChanged.removeListener(listener);\n    } catch {\n      // ignore — context may be gone\n    }\n  };\n}\n"

      "content": "/**\n * The one gate every user-imported plugin passes, on import and again on every\n * read by `LocalPluginSource`.\n *\n * It is the remote catalog's gate plus local-only rules, never a weaker one:\n *   - `validateManifest` with its CSS and rendered-sink guards, exactly as a\n *     remote catalog entry gets it;\n *   - the id is forced into the `local.*` namespace;\n *   - `tier` must be `declarative` (no plugin-supplied JS, ever);\n *   - every `native` op names a primitive this build ships, with params that\n *     match its published spec, and `engine` admits no build older than it\n *     (the same rule `plugin:check` applies to official plugins);\n *   - every match pattern stays inside a site Voyager already supports: a\n *     plugin platform (the D18 rule official plugins follow) or a native\n *     surface (Gemini, AI Studio), so enabling a local plugin can only ask for\n *     host access Voyager already has or an official plugin could ask for;\n *   - the packaged host policy (`manifestHostPolicyIssues`), checked for each\n *     native surface the patterns reach: no `theme` there (Gemini and AI Studio\n *     keep Voyager's own accent; the popup's accent picker changes it), and a\n *     `native` op only for a public primitive explicitly listed in an owner\n *     entry's handlers (`featureOwners.ts`). Fixed-id builtins may own a\n *     feature without opening a public primitive.\n *     Import, paste and the CLI enforce this; reading already stored plugins\n *     passes `hostPolicy: 'defer'` instead, so\n *     a build that closes a primitive again (a rolled-back owner entry)\n *     keeps the user's plugin listed and `PluginHost` reports it as\n *     `blocked: host-policy` by the page's real host. Defer skips only this\n *     site policy, never the CSS, DOM, params, namespace or other checks;\n *   - the local-only rules in `localPluginRules.ts`: `gv-` classes, semantic\n *     keys and `site.json` sections every targeted site declares, settings the\n *     popup can render, and no `folders` on Gemini or AI Studio.\n */\nimport type { Result } from '@/core/types/common';\n\nimport {\n  primitiveParamIssues,\n  primitiveSettingIssues,\n  primitiveShippabilityIssues,\n} from '../manifest/primitiveChecks';\nimport { type ManifestIssue, validateManifest } from '../manifest/validate';\nimport { manifestHostPolicyIssues } from '../sites/hostPolicy';\nimport { patternWithinAny } from '../sites/matchPattern';\nimport { DEFAULT_ADAPTERS } from '../sites/registry';\nimport type { PluginManifest, SiteAdapter } from '../types';\nimport { toLocalPluginId } from './localPluginId';\nimport { localPluginRuleIssues } from './localPluginRules';\n\nexport interface ValidatedLocalPlugin {\n  readonly manifest: PluginManifest;\n  /** The input with its id namespaced: what the store persists. */\n  readonly raw: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;\n}\n\nfunction isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {\n  return typeof value === 'object' && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);\n}\n\nexport interface ValidateLocalManifestOptions {\n  /**\n   * `enforce` (default) refuses what the packaged host policy refuses: the\n   * import, paste and CLI paths. `defer` leaves that verdict to the runtime,\n   * for re-reading plugins the user already stored.\n   */\n  readonly hostPolicy?: 'enforce' | 'defer';\n}\n\nexport function validateLocalManifest(\n  input: unknown,\n  sites: readonly SiteAdapter[] = DEFAULT_ADAPTERS,\n  options: ValidateLocalManifestOptions = {},\n): Result<ValidatedLocalPlugin, ManifestIssue[]> {\n  if (!isRecord(input)) {\n    return { success: false, error: [{ path: '', message: 'manifest must be a JSON object' }] };\n  }\n  const engine = typeof input.engine === 'string' ? input.engine.trim() : input.engine;\n  if (engine === '>=next' || engine === 'next') {\n    return {\n      success: false,\n      error: [\n        {\n          path: 'engine',\n          message:\n            'local plugins need a concrete engine version; replace \">=next\" with \">=x.y.z\" from the primitive reference',\n        },\n      ],\n    };\n  }\n  const issues: ManifestIssue[] = [];\n  let raw: Record<string, unknown> = input;\n  if (typeof input.id === 'string' && input.id.trim() !== '') {\n    const id = toLocalPluginId(input.id);\n    if (id) {\n      raw = { ...input, id };\n    } else {\n      issues.push({\n        path: 'id',\n        message: 'must be a lowercase reverse-dotted id (a-z, 0-9, \".\", \"_\", \"-\"), up to 100 chars',\n      });\n    }\n  }\n  if (input.tier === 'scripted') {\n    issues.push({ path: 'tier', message: 'local plugins must be declarative' });\n  }\n\n  const result = validateManifest(raw);\n  if (!result.success) return { success: false, error: [...issues, ...result.error] };\n  const manifest = result.data;\n\n  issues.push(\n    ...primitiveShippabilityIssues(manifest),\n    ...primitiveParamIssues(manifest),\n    ...primitiveSettingIssues(manifest),\n  );\n  const `matches[${index}]`,\n      message: `\"${pattern}\" is outside the sites plugins can target (${supported.join(', ')})`,\n    });\n  });\n  if (options.hostPolicy !== 'defer') issues.push(...manifestHostPolicyIssues(manifest));\n  issues.push(...localPluginRuleIssues(manifest, sites));\n\n  return issues.length > 0\n    ? { success: false, error: issues }\n    : { success: On Gemini / AI Studio the\n *      legacy switches packaged official plugins follow are read beside this,\n *      off the op chain: those plugins join in the reconcile after that read\n *      lands, once the content script admits them (`officialAdmission.ts`)\n *   4. reconcile: mount every plugin that (matches URL) AND (is enabled) AND\n *      (satisfies the engine version) AND (is not entitlement-locked) AND\n *      (wins the page-wide runtimes it needs, `resourceArbiter.ts`); unmount\n *      the rest. Re-application happens only when new nodes appear (SPA re-renders),\n *    coalesced to one pass per animation frame.\n *  - **Platform-agnostic.** Pure DOM APIs — works identically on Chrome, Firefox\n *    and Safari.\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\n\nimport {\n  PLUGIN_BASE_STYLE_ID,\n  PLUGIN_HIDDEN_CLASS,\n  PLUGIN_MARKER_ATTR,\n  PLUGIN_STYLE_ID_PREFIX,\n} from '../constants';\nimport { renderSettingTemplate, styleSheetIssue } from '../manifest/sinkGuards';\nimport type {\n  DomOperation,\n  PluginManifest,\n  PluginSettings,\n  SelectorRef,\n  SiteAdapter,\n} from '../types';\nimport { DomEffectLedger } from './domEffectLedger';\nimport { type HealthMonitorOptions, type HealthSample, HealthMonitor } from './healthMonitor';\nimport { type NativeHandler, getNativeHandler } from './nativeHandlers';\nimport { diagnoseOps } from './opDiagnostics';\nimport { PluginScope } from './pluginScope';\nimport {\n  type PrimitiveEnv,\n  type PrimitiveSlot,\n  activatePrimitives,\n  updatePrimitiveSettings,\n} from './primitiveLifecycle';\nimport { resolveSemanticElements } from './semanticElements';\nimport { applyOpToElement, isTargetedOp } from './targetedOps';\n\ninterface ActivePlugin extends PrimitiveSlot {\n  styleEl: HTMLStyleElement | null;\n  /** Current resolved setting values for CSS, DOM operations and native params. */\n  settings: PluginSettings;\n  /** First-party start/stop bound to a builtin plugin id (see nativeHandlers). */\n  nativeHandler?: NativeHandler;\n  /** Side-effect ledger for a scope-based (`activate`) native handler. */\n  scope?: PluginScope;\n  /** Serializes settings-driven scope restarts (dispose → re-activate). */\n  scopeRestart?: Promise<void>;\n}\n\nexport interface DeclarativeEngineOptions {\n  /** Only an installed remote page profile needs to distinguish native decorations from our UI. */\n  readonly trackNativeDecorations?: boolean;\n  /** Document to operate on. Runtimes that are one per page wait\n   * for it before a successor starts (`releaseLedger.ts`).\n   */\n  unmount(id: string): Promise<void> {\n    const entry = this.active.get(id);\n    if (!entry) return Promise.resolve();\n\n    // Scope disposal is async (it awaits in-flight startup and async\n    // disposers) but claim-once: firing it here and moving on is safe — no\n    // effect can double-run or leak, and a remount gets a fresh scope.\n    const teardown: Array<Promise<void> | undefined> = [entry.scopeRestart, entry.primitiveRestart];\n    if (entry.scope) teardown.push(entry.scope.dispose());\n    else entry.nativeHandler?.stop?.();\n    if (entry.primitiveScope) teardown.push(entry.primitiveScope.dispose());\n    entry.primitiveScope = undefined;\n    entry.styleEl?.remove();\n    this.releasePlugin(id);\n    this.health.forget(id);\n\n    this.active.delete(id);\n    this.syncObserver();\n    logger.info('Plugin unmounted', { id });\n    const released = Promise.allSettled(teardown).then(() => undefined);\n    this.onRelease?.(entry.manifest, released);\n    return released;\n  }\n\n  unmountAll(): void {\n    // oxlint-disable-next-line unicorn/no-useless-spread -- snapshot: the loop body mutates the collection\n    for (const id of [...this.active.keys()]) void this.unmount(id);\n    this.doc.getElementById(PLUGIN_BASE_STYLE_ID)?.remove();\n    this.health.dispose();\n  }\n\n  /** Re-apply all active plugins' dom ops immediately (exposed for tests + the\n   *  rAF scheduler). Idempotent. */\n  reapplyNow(): void {\n    this.ledger.restoreDetached();\n    for (const entry of this.active.values()) this.applyDomOps(entry);\n  }\n\n  // --- internals -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n  private ensureBaseStyle(): void {\n    if (this.doc.getElementById(PLUGIN_BASE_STYLE_ID)) return;\n    const style = this.doc.createElement('style');\n    style.id = PLUGIN_BASE_STYLE_ID;\n    style.textContent = `.${PLUGIN_HIDDEN_CLASS}{display:none !important;}`;\n    this.styleRoot().appendChild(style);\n  }\n\n  private styleRoot(): Element {\n    return this.doc.head ?? this.doc.documentElement;\n  }\n\n  private injectStyles(entry: ActivePlugin): void {\n    const css = this.renderCss(entry);\n    if (!css) return;\n    const style = this.doc.createElement('style');\n    style.id = `${PLUGIN_STYLE_ID_PREFIX}${entry.manifest.id}`;\n    style.setAttribute(PLUGIN_MARKER_ATTR, entry.manifest.id);\n    style.textContent = css;\n    this.styleRoot().appendChild(style);\n    entry.styleEl = style;\n  }\n\n  /** Join the plugin's CSS and substitute `{{key}}` tokens with the current\n   *  setting values (falling back to each setting's declared default). This is\n   *  bounded parameter substitution over declared keys — NOT a remote\n   *  mini-language — so it stays within Chrome's \"data, not code\" allowance.\n   *  Stored setting values never passed the manifest validator, so the rendered\n   *  text is checked again and withheld whole when it could fetch remotely. */\n  private renderCss(entry: ActivePlugin): string {\n    const styles = entry.manifest.contributes.styles;\n    if (!styles || styles.length === 0) return '';\n    const css = this.renderTemplate(\n      entry,\n      styles.map((contribution) => contribution.css).join('\\n'),\n    );\n    const issue = styleSheetIssue(css);\n    if (issue) {\n      logger.warn('Rendered plugin CSS rejected', { id: entry.manifest.id, issue });\n      return '';\n    }\n    return css;\n  }\n\n  private renderTemplate(entry: ActivePlugin, value: string): string {\n    return renderSettingTemplate(value, entry.manifest.contributes.settings, entry.settings);\n  }\n\n  private resolveSelector(ref: SelectorRef): string | null {\n    if (ref.kind === 'css') return ref.selector;\n    const selector = this.targetAdapter?.selectors[ref.key];\n    if (!selector) {\n      logger.warn('Unknown semantic selector key', {\n        key: ref.key,\n        site: this.adapter?.id ?? 'none',\n      });\n      return null;\n    }\n    return selector;\n  }\n\n  private queryAll(ref: SelectorRef): Element[] {\n    if (ref.kind === 'semantic') {\n      const elements = resolveSemanticElements(this.doc, this.targetAdapter, ref.key);\n      if (elements) return [...elements];\n    }\n    const selector = this.resolveSelector(ref);\n    if (!selector) return [];\n    try {\n      return Array.from(this.doc.querySelectorAll(selector));\n    } catch {\n      logger.warn('Invalid selector', { selector });\n      return [];\n    }\n  }\n\n  private applyDomOps(entry: ActivePlugin): void {\n    const ops = entry.manifest.contributes.domOps;\n    if (!ops) return;\n    for (const op of ops) this.applyOp(entry, op);\n  }\n\n  private applyOp(entry: ActivePlugin, op: DomOperation): void {\n    if (!isTargetedOp(op)) return; // primitives run through activatePrimitives\n    const render = (value: string): string => this.renderTemplate(entry, value);\n    for (const el of this.queryAll(op.target)) {\n      if (!applyOpToElement(this.ledger, entry.manifest.id, el, op, render)) return;\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Remove every contribution of `id` from the shared ledgers. */\n  private releasePlugin(id: string): void {\n    this.ledger.release(id);\n  }\n\n  /** Observe only while some active plugin actually has domOps or awaits a\n   *  health verdict — pure-CSS plugins get their behaviour from the\n   *  stylesheet alone, and paying a MutationObserver callback per DOM change\n   *  for them is wasted work. */\n  private syncObserver(): void {\n    if (this.hasActiveDomOps() || this.health.hasTracked()) this.ensureObserver();\n    else this.disconnectObserver();\n  }\n\n  private hasActiveDomOps(): boolean {\n    for (const entry of this.active.values()) {\n      if (entry.manifest.contributes.domOps?.some(isTargetedOp)) return true;\n    }\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  private ensureObserver(): void {\n    if (this.observer) return;\n    const target = this.doc.body ?? this.doc.documentElement;\n    if (!target) return;\n    this.observer = new MutationObserver(() => {\n      this.health.noteMutation();\n      if (this.hasActiveDomOps()) this.scheduleReapply();\n    });\n    this.observer.observe(target, { childList: true, subtree: true });\n  }\n\n  private disconnectObserver(): void {\n    this.observer?.disconnect();\n    this.observer = null;\n  }\n\n  private scheduleReapply(): void {\n    if (this.reapplyScheduled) return;\n    this.reapplyScheduled = true;\n    const run = (): void => {\n      this.reapplyScheduled = false;\n      this.reapplyNow();\n    };\n    if (typeof requestAnimationFrame === 'function') requestAnimationFrame(run);\n    else setTimeout(run, 16);\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/domEffectLedger.ts",
      "content": "import { hasVoyagerOwner } from '@/core/gemini/composer/ownedInput';\nimport { nativeDomDecorations } from '@/core/services/NativeDomDecorationService';\n\n/**\n * DomEffectLedger — the engine-level, ref-counted record of every class,\n * attribute and inline style the declarative plugins wrote (see the\n * `DeclarativeEngine` class doc). When two plugins touch the same\n * class/attribute/style, the *true* pre-plugin original is captured once;\n * releasing one plugin restores the value of the other still-active plugin\n * (last writer wins), and only the last release restores the original.\n */\nimport { InlineStyleParser } from './inlineStyleDeclarations';\nimport { InlineStyleLedger } from './inlineStyleLedger';\n\n/**\n * One overwritten attribute. `original` is the value *before any\n * plugin touched it* (captured once): `null` = attribute was absent.\n * `stack` holds each active plugin's desired value; the\n * top entry is the one currently written to the DOM (last writer wins).\n */\ninterface OverrideLayer {\n  readonly original: string | null;\n  readonly stack: Array<{ id: string; value: string }>;\n}\n\nexport class DomEffectLedger {\n  /** element → className → set of plugin ids that requested the class. */\n  private readonly classOwners = new Map<Element, Map<string, Set<string>>>();\n  /** element → attribute name → layer. */\n  private readonly attrLayers = new Map<Element, Map<string, OverrideLayer>>();\n  /** Shared original longhands and ordered declarations, including variable shorthands. */\n  private readonly styleLayers = new Map<HTMLElement, InlineStyleLedger>();\n  /** Expands `style` attribute values and `setStyle` entries into longhands. */\n  private styleParser: InlineStyleParser | null = null;\n\n  constructor(\n    private readonly doc: Document,\n    private readonly trackNativeDecorations = false,\n  ) {}\n\n  addClass(id: string, el: Element, className: string): void {\n    const perEl = mapGet(this.classOwners, el, () => new Map<string, Set<string>>());\n    const owners = mapGet(perEl, className, () => new Set<string>());\n    // Native decorations must not make later guarded semantic reads mistake the host for our UI.\n    if (\n      this.trackNativeDecorations &&\n      !hasVoyagerOwner(el) &&\n      !el.closest('[data-gv-component], [data-gv-layer], [data-gv-plugin]')\n    )\n      nativeDomDecorations.acquire(el, className, this);\n    owners.add(id);\n    // (Re)assert the class — also re-heals an SPA re-render that stripped it.\n    if (!el.classList.contains(className)) el.classList.add(className);\n  }\n\n  setAttribute(id: string, el: Element, name: string, value: string): void {\n    const perEl = mapGet(this.attrLayers, el, () => new Map<string, OverrideLayer>());\n    const layer = mapGet(perEl, name, () => ({ original: el.getAttribute(name), stack: [] }));\n    pushLayerValue(layer, id, value);\n    el.setAttribute(name, topValue(layer));\n  }\n\n  setStyle(id: string, el: HTMLElement, prop: string, value: string, priority = ''): void {\n    const ledger = mapGet(this.styleLayers, el, () => new InlineStyleLedger(el));\n    ledger.set(id, [prop, value, priority], this.styles().properties(prop));\n  }\n\n  styles(): InlineStyleParser {\n    this.styleParser ??= new InlineStyleParser(this.doc);\n    return this.styleParser;\n  }\n\n  /** Remove every contribution of `id`, restoring the next-highest plugin's\n   *  value (or the captured original when it was last). */\n  release(id: string): void {\n    for (const [el, perEl] of this.classOwners) {\n      for (const [className, owners] of perEl) {\n        if (owners.delete(id) && owners.size === 0) {\n          if (this.trackNativeDecorations) nativeDomDecorations.release(el, className, this);\n          el.classList.remove(className);\n          perEl.delete(className);\n        }\n      }\n      if (perEl.size === 0) this.classOwners.delete(el);\n    }\n\n    for (const [el, perEl] of this.attrLayers) {\n      for (const [name, layer] of perEl) {\n        if (!removeLayerValue(layer, id)) continue;\n        if (layer.stack.length === 0) {\n          if (layer.original === null) el.removeAttribute(name);\n          else el.setAttribute(name, layer.original);\n          perEl.delete(name);\n        } else {\n          el.setAttribute(name, topValue(layer));\n        }\n      }\n      if (perEl.size === 0) this.attrLayers.delete(el);\n    }\n\n    for (const [el, ledger] of this.styleLayers) {\n      if (ledger.release(id)) this.styleLayers.delete(el);\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Restore detached elements before dropping their ledger entries. This\n   *  prevents the ledgers from pinning replaced SPA subtrees while preserving\n   *  reversibility if a framework later reattaches the same element. */\n  restoreDetached(): void {\n    for (const [el, perEl] of this.classOwners) {\n      if (this.doc.contains(el)) continue;\n      for (const className of perEl.keys()) {\n        if (this.trackNativeDecorations) nativeDomDecorations.release(el, className, this);\n        el.classList.remove(className);\n      }\n      this.classOwners.delete(el);\n    }\n\n    for (const [el, perEl] of this.attrLayers) {\n      if (this.doc.contains(el)) continue;\n      for (const [name, layer] of perEl) {\n        if (layer.original === null) el.removeAttribute(name);\n        else el.setAttribute(name, layer.original);\n      }\n      this.attrLayers.delete(el);\n    }\n\n    for (const [el, ledger] of this.styleLayers) {\n      if (this.doc.contains(el)) continue;\n      ledger.restore();\n      this.styleLayers.delete(el);\n    }\n  }\n}\n\nfunction mapGet<K, V>(map: Map<K, V>, key: K, create: () => V): V {\n  let value = map.get(key);\n  if (value === undefined) {\n    value = create();\n    map.set(key, value);\n  }\n  return value;\n}\n\n/** Update-or-insert a plugin's desired value, moving it to the top of the stack. */\nfunction pushLayerValue(layer: OverrideLayer, id: string, value: string): void {\n  removeLayerValue(layer, id);\n  layer.stack.push({ id, value });\n}\n\n/** Remove a plugin's entry from the stack. Returns true if one was present. */\nfunction removeLayerValue(layer: OverrideLayer, id: string): boolean {\n  const index = layer.stack.findIndex((entry) => entry.id === id);\n  if (index < 0) return false;\n  layer.stack.splice(index, 1);\n  return true;\n}\n\nfunction topValue(layer: OverrideLayer): string {\n  return layer.stack[layer.stack.length - 1].value;\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/healthMonitor.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * HealthMonitor — the \"no effect on this page\" signal (plan D12, §4.4).\n *\n * A mounted plugin that touches the page (DOM ops or a primitive) is expected\n * to find at least one target once the conversation has rendered. The monitor\n * waits until the DOM has been QUIET for a while (no childList mutations),\n * then compares the site's user-turn count with the plugin's target count:\n *\n *   userTurns > 0 && targets === 0  →  no effect (yellow in the popup)\n *   targets > 0                      →  cleared immediately on the next check\n *   userTurns === 0                  →  never flagged (empty conversation)\n *\n * The same verdict also names the ops that found nothing although the page\n * shows what they need (`missingOps` in `opDiagnostics.ts`): a `sidebar` op\n * that stopped matching after a redesign, say, while another op on `body`\n * keeps the plugin-wide count above zero. Those ops are reported beside the\n * flag, never instead of it, and `page` keys are judged on an empty chat too.\n *\n * Quiet detection drives the timing so a slow network never produces a false\n * positive; a fixed deadline only caps how long the first verdict may wait.\n * Pure-CSS plugins are never tracked (they have no countable targets). The\n * engine's own MutationObserver feeds `noteMutation`; the monitor installs\n * none of its own.\n */\nimport { type OpDiagnostic, missingOps } from './opDiagnostics';\n\nexport interface HealthMonitorOptions {\n  /** Elements the site adapter recognises as user turns; 0 means \"empty page\". */\n  readonly countUserTurns: () => number;\n  readonly onChange?: (id: string, noEffect: boolean, zeroOps: readonly number[]) => void;\n  /** DOM silence required before a verdict. */\n  readonly quietMs?: number;\n  /** Upper bound on the wait for the first verdict after a plugin is tracked. */\n  readonly maxWaitMs?: number;\n}\n\nexport const HEALTH_QUIET_MS = 1_500;\nexport const HEALTH_MAX_WAIT_MS = 10_000;\n\n/** One look at a plugin's targets. */\nexport interface HealthSample {\n  /** Elements its ops and primitive counters found, page-root targets included. */\n  readonly targets: number;\n  /** Its targeted ops, each with its own count. */\n  readonly ops: readonly OpDiagnostic[];\n}\n\ninterface Tracked {\n  readonly sample: () => HealthSample;\n  noEffect: boolean | undefined;\n  zeroOps: readonly number[];\n}\n\nconst EMPTY_SAMPLE: HealthSample = { targets: 0, ops: [] };\n\nexport class HealthMonitor {\n  private readonly countUserTurns: () => number;\n  private readonly onChange?: HealthMonitorOptions['onChange'];\n  private readonly quietMs: number;\n  private readonly maxWaitMs: number;\n  private readonly tracked = new Map<string, Tracked>();\n  private quietTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;\n  private deadlineTimer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null = null;\n  private lastMutationAt = 0;\n  private disposed = false;\n\n  constructor(options: HealthMonitorOptions) {\n    this.countUserTurns = options.countUserTurns;\n    this.onChange = options.onChange;\n    this.quietMs = options.quietMs ?? HEALTH_QUIET_MS;\n    this.maxWaitMs = options.maxWaitMs ?? HEALTH_MAX_WAIT_MS;\n  }\n\n  /** Start watching a plugin. Its first verdict arrives after the next quiet period. */\n  track(id: string, sample: () => HealthSample): void {\n    if (this.disposed) return;\n    this.tracked.set(id, { sample, noEffect: undefined, zeroOps: [] });\n    this.armQuietTimer();\n    this.armDeadline();\n  }\n\n  forget(id: string): void {\n    this.tracked.delete(id);\n    if (this.tracked.size === 0) this.stopWatching();\n  }\n\n  /** True while at least one plugin awaits or holds a verdict (the owner keeps observing). */\n  hasTracked(): boolean {\n    return this.tracked.size > 0;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * The owner's MutationObserver reports childList mutations here; the\n   * monitor shares that observer instead of installing a second one.\n   */\n  noteMutation(): void {\n    if (this.disposed || this.tracked.size === 0) return;\n    this.lastMutationAt = Date.now();\n    this.armQuietTimer();\n  }\n\n  /** `true` = flagged as having no effect; `false` = healthy; `undefined` = no verdict yet. */\n  get(id: string): boolean | undefined {\n    return this.tracked.get(id)?.noEffect;\n  }\n\n  /** `domOps` indexes the last verdict found nothing for (see the class doc); `[]` before one. */\n  zeroOps(id: string): readonly number[] {\n    return this.tracked.get(id)?.zeroOps ?? [];\n  }\n\n  /** Evaluate every tracked plugin now (tests, and the quiet/deadline timers). */\n  evaluateNow(): void {\n    if (this.disposed || this.tracked.size === 0) return;\n    this.clearDeadline();\n    const userTurns = this.countUserTurns();\n    for (const [id, entry] of this.tracked) {\n      let sample = EMPTY_SAMPLE;\n      try {\n        sample = entry.sample();\n      } catch {\n        // A throwing sample reports nothing.\n      }\n      const noEffect = userTurns > 0 && sample.targets === 0;\n      const zeroOps = missingOps(sample.ops, userTurns);\n      if (entry.noEffect !== noEffect || !sameIndexes(entry.zeroOps, zeroOps)) {\n        entry.noEffect = noEffect;\n        entry.zeroOps = zeroOps;\n        this.onChange?.(id, noEffect, zeroOps);\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  dispose(): void {\n    this.disposed = true;\n    this.tracked.clear();\n    this.stopWatching();\n  }\n\n  private armQuietTimer(): void {\n    if (this.quietTimer) clearTimeout(this.quietTimer);\n    this.quietTimer = setTimeout(() => {\n      this.quietTimer = null;\n      if (Date.now() - this.lastMutationAt < this.quietMs) {\n        this.armQuietTimer();\n        return;\n      }\n      this.evaluateNow();\n    }, this.quietMs);\n  }\n\n  private armDeadline(): void {\n    if (this.deadlineTimer) return;\n    this.deadlineTimer = setTimeout(() => {\n      this.deadlineTimer = null;\n      this.evaluateNow();\n    }, this.maxWaitMs);\n  }\n\n  private clearDeadline(): void {\n    if (this.deadlineTimer) clearTimeout(this.deadlineTimer);\n    this.deadlineTimer = null;\n  }\n\n  private stopWatching(): void {\n    if (this.quietTimer) clearTimeout(this.quietTimer);\n    this.quietTimer = null;\n    this.clearDeadline();\n  }\n}\n\nfunction sameIndexes(a: readonly number[], b: readonly number[]): boolean {\n  return a.length === b.length && a.every((value, i) => value === b[i]);\n}\n"
    },
