      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/hostEngine.ts",
      "content": "import { withGuardedPageAdapter } from '@/core/selectors/semanticSnapshot';\n/**\n * The engine a `PluginHost` mounts into: health tracking for the features\n * that want it, the host's own statuses for primitives that inspect them, and\n * every runtime release recorded in the host's ledger.\n */\nimport { getSiteSelectorView } from '@/core/selectors/service';\nimport { getPageSelectorSiteId } from '@/core/selectors/sites';\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\n\nimport { tracksPluginHealth } from '../sites/featureOwners';\nimport type { SiteAdapter } from '../types';\nimport { DeclarativeEngine } from './declarativeEngine';\nimport type { PrimitiveEnv } from './primitiveLifecycle';\nimport type { ReleaseLedger } from './releaseLedger';\nimport { claimedResources } from './resourceClaims';\n\nexport interface HostEngineOptions {\n  readonly doc: Document;\n  readonly adapter: SiteAdapter | null;\n  /** The host's statuses and running manifests, read when a primitive asks. */\n  readonly inspectPlugins: NonNullable<PrimitiveEnv['inspectPlugins']>;\n  /** Kept by the host across engines, so a successor never starts beside a runtime still shutting down. */\n  readonly releases: ReleaseLedger;\n}\n\nexport function createHostEngine(options: HostEngineOptions): DeclarativeEngine {\n  const siteId = getPageSelectorSiteId(options.doc);\n  const trackNativeDecorations =\n    siteId !== null &&\n    options.adapter?.id === siteId &&\n    getSiteSelectorView(siteId).remoteKeys.size > 0;\n  return new DeclarativeEngine({\n    doc: options.doc,\n    trackNativeDecorations,\n    adapter: withGuardedPageAdapter(options.adapter, options.doc),\n    targetAdapter: withGuardedPageAdapter(options.adapter, options.doc, 'declarative'),\n    onHealthChange: (id, noEffect) => {\n      logger.info('Plugin health changed', { id, noEffect });\n    },\n    shouldTrackHealth: (manifest) => tracksPluginHealth(manifest.id),\n    inspectPlugins: options.inspectPlugins,\n    // The mounted manifest decides what is released, so a plugin frozen\n    // on its old version (D7) releases what that version claimed.\n    onRelease: (manifest, released) => {\n      options.releases.record(manifest.id, claimedResources(manifest), released);\n    },\n  });\n}\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/mountedSettings.ts",
      "content": "import type { PluginManifest, PluginSettings } from '../types';\nimport type { DeclarativeEngine } from './declarativeEngine';\n\n/**\n * Mount a plugin the pass lets run. One already active gets its settings\n * pushed, but only when they changed since the last push (`pushed`, by id):\n * a state write for plugin A must not re-render every other active plugin.\n */\nexport function mountOrUpdate(\n  engine: DeclarativeEngine,\n  pushed: Map<string, string>,\n  manifest: PluginManifest,\n  settings: PluginSettings,\n): void {\n  const serialized = JSON.stringify(settings);\n  if (!engine.isActive(manifest.id)) {\n    engine.mount(manifest, settings);\n  } else if (pushed.get(manifest.id) !== serialized) {\n    engine.updateSettings(manifest.id, settings);\n  } else {\n    return;\n  }\n  pushed.set(manifest.id, serialized);\n}\n\n/** Unmount each running plugin of `manifests` that `drop` names, forgetting its last push. */\nexport function unmountWhere(\n  engine: DeclarativeEngine,\n  pushed: Map<string, string>,\n  manifests: readonly PluginManifest[],\n  drop: (id: string) => boolean,\n): void {\n  for (const manifest of manifests) {\n    if (!engine.isActive(manifest.id) || !drop(manifest.id)) continue;\n    void engine.unmount(manifest.id);\n    pushed.delete(manifest.id);\n  }\n}\n"
    },
    {
      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/pluginScope.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * PluginScope — the side-effect ledger for builtin (native-function) plugins.\n *\n * Every side effect a plugin creates (listener, observer, DOM node, timer,\n * injected style, network task) is registered through this scope and paid back\n * automatically, in reverse registration order, when the scope is disposed.\n * Plugins never hand-write teardown pairs; the host owns the ledger.\n *\n * Design cribbed from cordis (`fiber.effect`) with three deliberate cuts:\n * no Context proxy, no service dependency graph, no event bus.\n *\n * Ledger semantics (each entry is claim-once):\n *  - An effect occupies its ledger slot at REGISTRATION time, even when its\n *    disposer arrives later from a Promise — so `dispose()` is a real barrier\n *    that awaits in-flight startup work, and teardown order always follows\n *    registration order, not settlement order.\n *  - Every entry is disposed exactly once, whether through the effect's own\n *    remover, `dispose()`, or a mid-flight cancellation — concurrent callers\n *    await the same settlement instead of re-running the disposer.\n *  - `signal` aborts when disposal begins; bind all cancellable work to it.\n *  - One failing disposer is logged and never blocks the rest.\n *  - Contract: a disposer must not await `scope.dispose()` (self-deadlock),\n *    and effects cannot be registered once disposal has begun.\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\nimport {\n  hasValidExtensionContext,\n  isExtensionContextInvalidatedError,\n} from '@/core/utils/extensionContext';\n\nexport type Dispose = () => void | Promise<void>;\n\ntype EffectResult = Dispose | Promise<Dispose> | Iterable<Dispose>;\n\n/** chrome.* event objects (e.g. chrome.storage.onChanged) are not EventTargets. */\nexport interface ChromeEventLike<F extends (...args: never[]) => void> {\n  addListener(listener: F): void;\n  removeListener(listener: F): void;\n}\n\nconst enum EntryState {\n  /** Waiting for its Promise-borne disposer to arrive. */\n  PENDING,\n  /** Disposer present, not yet claimed. */\n  LIVE,\n  /** Some caller owns disposal; `settled` tracks completion. */\n  CLAIMED,\n  /** Disposer finished (or entry cancelled with nothing to run). */\n  DONE,\n}\n\nclass LedgerEntry {\n  state = EntryState.LIVE;\n  dispose: Dispose | null = null;\n  /** Settlement of this entry's disposal once claimed. */\n  settled: Promise<void> | null = null;\n  /** Set when the entry is released (remover/dispose) while still PENDING. */\n  cancelled = false;\n  /** For PENDING entries: resolves when the startup promise has settled. */\n  arrival: Promise<void> | null = null;\n\n  constructor(public readonly label: string) {}\n}\n\nexport class PluginScope {\n  private readonly ledger: LedgerEntry[] = [];\n  private readonly abort = new AbortController();\n  private disposed = false;\n  private disposal: Promise<void> | null = null;\n  /** Fire-and-forget cleanup work (mid-way rollbacks) the barrier must await. */\n  private readonly looseEnds = new Set<Promise<void>>();\n\n  /** Aborts when disposal begins. Bind fetches and cancellable loops to it. */\n  get signal(): AbortSignal {\n    return this.abort.signal;\n  }\n\n  get isDisposed(): boolean {\n    return this.disposed;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Register a side effect. `run` performs the effect and returns its\n   * disposer — directly, via a Promise, or as an iterable of several.\n   * Throwing mid-way rolls back whatever was already collected. The returned\n   * remover disposes just this effect, exactly once, however often called.\n   */\n  effect(run: () => EffectResult, label = 'anonymous'): Dispose {\n    this.assertLive(label);\n    const entries: LedgerEntry[] = [];\n    try {\n      const result = run();\n      if (typeof result === 'function') {\n        entries.push(this.addLiveEntry(label, result));\n      } else if (result && typeof (result as Promise<Dispose>).then === 'function') {\n        entries.push(this.addPendingEntry(label, result as Promise<Dispose>));\n      } else if (result && Symbol.iterator in (result as Iterable<Dispose>)) {\n        for (const dispose of result as Iterable<Dispose>) {\n          if (typeof dispose !== 'function') throw new TypeError('Invalid effect disposer');\n          entries.push(this.addLiveEntry(label, dispose));\n        }\n      } else if (result !== undefined && result !== null) {\n        throw new TypeError('Invalid effect result');\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Roll back whatever landed before the throw; the barrier awaits it.\n      for (const entry of entries.splice(0).reverse()) {\n        this.trackLooseEnd(this.release(entry));\n      }\n      throw error;\n    }\n    // `run` may have disposed the scope synchronously; nothing may outlive it.\n    if (this.disposed) {\n      for (const entry of entries.slice().reverse()) this.trackLooseEnd(this.release(entry));\n    }\n    return async () => {\n      for (const entry of entries.slice().reverse()) {\n        await this.release(entry);\n      }\n    };\n  }\n\n  /** Adopt an existing component's destroy() chain (e.g. a preview panel). */\n  child(target: { destroy: () => void | Promise<void> }, label = 'child'): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => () => target.destroy(), label);\n  }\n\n  /** addEventListener with automatic removal. Accepts DOM/window targets. */\n  on<K extends keyof GlobalEventHandlersEventMap>(\n    target: EventTarget,\n    type: K,\n    listener: (event: GlobalEventHandlersEventMap[K]) => void,\n    options?: AddEventListenerOptions,\n  ): Dispose;\n  on(\n    target: EventTarget,\n    type: string,\n    listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject,\n    options?: AddEventListenerOptions,\n  ): Dispose;\n  on(\n    target: EventTarget,\n    type: string,\n    listener: EventListenerOrEventListenerObject,\n    options?: AddEventListenerOptions,\n  ): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => {\n      target.addEventListener(type, listener as EventListener, options);\n      return () => target.removeEventListener(type, listener as EventListener, options);\n    }, `on(${type})`);\n  }\n\n  /** chrome.*.onX.addListener with automatic removal. */\n  onChromeEvent<F extends (...args: never[]) => void>(\n    event: ChromeEventLike<F>,\n    listener: F,\n  ): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => {\n      event.addListener(listener);\n      return () => {\n        try {\n          event.removeListener(listener);\n        } catch (error) {\n          // A reloaded extension's events are already gone, so nothing is left to remove.\n          if (hasValidExtensionContext() && !isExtensionContextInvalidatedError(error)) throw error;\n        }\n      };\n    }, 'onChromeEvent');\n  }\n\n  /** MutationObserver with automatic disconnect. */\n  observe(target: Node, options: MutationObserverInit, callback: MutationCallback): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => {\n      const observer = new MutationObserver(callback);\n      observer.observe(target, options);\n      return () => observer.disconnect();\n    }, 'observe');\n  }\n\n  /** Insert a DOM node with automatic removal. */\n  mount(el: Element, parent: Element, anchor: Element | null = null): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => {\n      parent.insertBefore(el, anchor);\n      return () => el.remove();\n    }, `mount(<${el.tagName.toLowerCase()}>)`);\n  }\n\n  /** Inject a <style> element (gv- prefixed CSS) with automatic removal. */\n  style(css: string, doc: Document = document): Dispose {\n    return this.effect(() => {\n      const el = doc.createElement('style');\n      el.setAttribute('data-gv-plugin-scope', '');\n      el.textContent = css;\n      doc.head.appendChild(el);\n      return () => el.remove();\n    }, 'style');\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * setTimeout / setInterval with automatic clearing. A one-shot timer\n   * releases its ledger slot when it fires, so debounce-style repeated\n   * scheduling never grows the ledger.\n   */\n  timer(fn: () => void, ms: number, options?: { repeat?: boolean }): Dispose {\n    if (options?.repeat) {\n      return this.effect(() => {\n        const id = setInterval(fn, ms);\n        return () => clearInterval(id);\n      }, `timer(${ms}ms)`);\n    }\n    let release: Dispose | null = null;\n    release = this.effect(() => {\n      const id = setTimeout(() => {\n        fn();\n        void release?.();\n      }, ms);\n      return () => clearTimeout(id);\n    }, `timer(${ms}ms)`);\n    return release;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * requestAnimationFrame (one-shot or loop) with automatic cancel. A\n   * one-shot frame releases its ledger slot after it runs.\n   */\n  frame(fn: FrameRequestCallback, options?: { repeat?: boolean }): Dispose {\n    let release: Dispose | null = null;\n    release = this.effect(() => {\n      let id = 0;\n      let stopped = false;\n      const tick: FrameRequestCallback = (time) => {\n        if (stopped) return;\n        fn(time);\n        if (options?.repeat && !stopped) id = requestAnimationFrame(tick);\n        else if (!options?.repeat) void release?.();\n      };\n      id = requestAnimationFrame(tick);\n      return () => {\n        stopped = true;\n        cancelAnimationFrame(id);\n      };\n    }, 'frame');\n    return release;\n  }\n\n  /** Labels of currently live/pending effects, newest last. Leak inspection. */\n  getEffects(): readonly string[] {\n    return this.ledger\n      .filter((entry) => entry.state === EntryState.PENDING || entry.state === EntryState.LIVE)\n      .map((entry) => entry.label);\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Abort the signal, then settle every entry in reverse registration order.\n   * A pending entry is awaited until its startup promise settles, so the\n   * returned promise is a true barrier: when it resolves, nothing registered\n   * through this scope is still alive or still starting. Idempotent.\n   */\n  dispose(): Promise<void> {\n    if (this.disposal) return this.disposal;\n    this.disposed = true;\n    // Publish the settlement before running any foreign code (abort listeners\n    // may re-enter dispose(); they must receive this same promise).\n    let settle!: () => void;\n    this.disposal = new Promise<void>((r) => (settle = r));\n    void (async () => {\n      try {\n        this.abort.abort();\n        for (const entry of this.ledger.slice().reverse()) {\n          await this.release(entry);\n        }\n        await Promise.allSettled(this.looseEnds);\n      } finally {\n        settle();\n      }\n    })();\n    return this.disposal;\n  }\n\n  private assertLive(label: string): void {\n    if (this.disposed) {\n      throw new Error(`PluginScope is disposed; cannot register effect \"${label}\"`);\n    }\n  }\n\n  private addLiveEntry(label: string, dispose: Dispose): LedgerEntry {\n    const entry = new LedgerEntry(label);\n    entry.dispose = dispose;\n    this.ledger.push(entry);\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  private addPendingEntry(label: string, promise: Promise<Dispose>): LedgerEntry {\n    const entry = new LedgerEntry(label);\n    entry.state = EntryState.PENDING;\n    this.ledger.push(entry);\n    entry.arrival = promise.then(\n      (dispose) => {\n        if (typeof dispose !== 'function') {\n          if (entry.state === EntryState.PENDING) this.finish(entry);\n          return;\n        }\n        if (entry.cancelled || this.disposed) {\n          // Released (or scope died) before startup finished: pay immediately.\n          entry.state = EntryState.CLAIMED;\n          entry.settled = this.runDisposer(entry.label, dispose);\n          return entry.settled.then(() => this.finish(entry));\n        }\n        entry.dispose = dispose;\n        entry.state = EntryState.LIVE;\n      },\n      (error) => {\n        if (entry.state === EntryState.PENDING) this.finish(entry);\n        logger.error('PluginScope effect failed', { label, error: String(error) });\n      },\n    );\n    return entry;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Settle one entry, exactly once. Concurrent callers share the settlement.\n   * A PENDING entry is cancelled and awaited until its arrival chain has run\n   * (and paid) the late disposer.\n   */\n  private release(entry: LedgerEntry): Promise<void> {\n    switch (entry.state) {\n      case EntryState.DONE:\n        return entry.settled ?? Promise.resolve();\n      case EntryState.CLAIMED:\n        return entry.settled ?? Promise.resolve();\n      case EntryState.PENDING:\n        entry.cancelled = true;\n        return entry.arrival ?? Promise.resolve();\n      case EntryState.LIVE: {\n        const dispose = entry.dispose!;\n        entry.state = EntryState.CLAIMED;\n        entry.settled = this.runDisposer(entry.label, dispose).then(() => this.finish(entry));\n        return entry.settled;\n      }\n    }\n  }\n\n  /** Mark an entry settled and physically drop it so the ledger stays bounded. */\n  private finish(entry: LedgerEntry): void {\n    entry.state = EntryState.DONE;\n    const index = this.ledger.indexOf(entry);\n    if (index >= 0) this.ledger.splice(index, 1);\n  }\n\n  private trackLooseEnd(work: Promise<void>): void {\n    this.looseEnds.add(work);\n    void work.finally(() => this.looseEnds.delete(work));\n  }\n\n  private async runDisposer(label: string, dispose: Dispose): Promise<void> {\n    try {\n      await dispose();\n    } catch (error) {\n      // The detail goes in the message: the extension error list shows a context object as [object Object].\n      const detail = error instanceof Error ? (error.stack ?? error.message) : String(error);\n      logger.error(`PluginScope disposer failed (${label}): ${detail}`);\n    }\n  }\n}\n"

      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/primitiveLifecycle.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * The `native` op half of a mounted plugin: every primitive it invokes runs\n * under one shared `PluginScope`, settings updates apply in place when every\n * handle can absorb them, and otherwise the scope restarts (serialized) under\n * the new values. The engine entry owns the state (`PrimitiveSlot`).\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\n\nimport { hasNativeParamTemplates, renderNativeParams } from '../manifest/nativeParamSettings';\nimport type { NativeOperation, PluginManifest, PluginSettings, SiteAdapter } from '../types';\nimport { getPrimitive } from '../verbs/registry';\nimport type { PluginInspection, PrimitiveHandle } from '../verbs/types';\nimport { PluginScope } from './pluginScope';\n\n/** The primitive state of one mounted plugin, held on its engine entry. */\nexport interface PrimitiveSlot {\n  readonly manifest: PluginManifest;\n  /** Current resolved settings; a queued restart for older ones activates nothing. */\n  settings: PluginSettings;\n  /** Side-effect ledger shared by the plugin's `native` op primitives. */\n  primitiveScope?: PluginScope;\n  /** Serializes settings-driven primitive restarts. */\n  primitiveRestart?: Promise<void>;\n  /** Target counters registered by primitives (health signal, plan D12). */\n  targetCounters: Array<() => number>;\n  /** Handles of successfully activated primitives (settings updates in place). */\n  primitiveHandles: PrimitiveHandle[];\n  /** Number of native ops that activated (handles may still be arriving). */\n  primitiveActivations: number;\n}\n\nexport interface PrimitiveEnv {\n  readonly doc: Document;\n  readonly adapter: SiteAdapter | null;\n  /** False once the slot's plugin was unmounted or remounted. */\n  readonly isCurrent: (slot: PrimitiveSlot) => boolean;\n  readonly inspectPlugins?: () => PluginInspection;\n}\n\nfunction nativeOps(manifest: PluginManifest): NativeOperation[] {\n  return (manifest.contributes.domOps ?? []).filter(\n    (op): op is NativeOperation => op.op === 'native',\n  );\n}\n\n/**\n * Run every `native` op of the plugin under one shared scope. An unknown\n * handler or invalid params are skipped with a warning; the status machine\n * has normally already reported them as needs-handler, so this is defence\n * in depth, never a crash.\n */\nexport function activatePrimitives(\n  entry: PrimitiveSlot,\n  settings: PluginSettings,\n  env: PrimitiveEnv,\n): void {\n  const ops = nativeOps(entry.manifest);\n  if (ops.length === 0) return;\n  const scope = new PluginScope();\n  entry.primitiveScope = scope;\n  entry.targetCounters = [];\n  entry.primitiveHandles = [];\n  entry.primitiveActivations = 0;\n  const context = {\n    doc: env.doc,\n    adapter: env.adapter,\n    pluginId: entry.manifest.id,\n    settings,\n    setTargetCounter: (count: () => number) => {\n      entry.targetCounters.push(count);\n    },\n    inspectPlugins: env.inspectPlugins,\n  };\n  for (const op of ops) {\n    const primitive = getPrimitive(op.handler);\n    if (!primitive) {\n      logger.warn('Unknown primitive', { id: entry.manifest.id, handler: op.handler });\n      continue;\n    }\n    const rendered = renderNativeParams(op.params, entry.manifest.contributes.settings, settings);\n    const params = rendered.success ? primitive.validateParams(rendered.data) : rendered;\n    if (!params.success) {\n      logger.warn('Invalid primitive params', {\n        id: entry.manifest.id,\n        handler: op.handler,\n        issues: params.error,\n      });\n      continue;\n    }\n    try {\n      const result = primitive.activate(scope, params.data, context);\n      entry.primitiveActivations += 1;\n      const adopt = (handle: void | PrimitiveHandle): void => {\n        if (handle && entry.primitiveScope === scope) entry.primitiveHandles.push(handle);\n      };\n      if (result instanceof Promise) {\n        result.then(adopt).catch((error) => {\n          logger.error('Primitive activation failed', {\n            id: entry.manifest.id,\n            handler: op.handler,\n            error: String(error),\n          });\n        });\n      } else {\n        adopt(result);\n      }\n    } catch (error) {\n      logger.error('Primitive activation failed', {\n        id: entry.manifest.id,\n        handler: op.handler,\n        error: String(error),\n      });\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n/**\n * Dispose the primitives' scope, then re-activate under the new settings\n * (serialized). Always chain: while a restart is still disposing there is no\n * scope to take, but the newer settings must still get their activation once\n * the queue drains — otherwise the stale restart bails on them and the plugin\n * ends up with no primitives at all.\n */\nexport function restartPrimitives(\n  entry: PrimitiveSlot,\n  settings: PluginSettings,\n  env: PrimitiveEnv,\n): void {\n  const previous = entry.primitiveScope;\n  entry.primitiveScope = undefined;\n  entry.primitiveRestart = (entry.primitiveRestart ?? Promise.resolve()).then(async () => {\n    if (previous) await previous.dispose();\n    if (!env.isCurrent(entry)) return;\n    if (entry.settings !== settings) return;\n    activatePrimitives(entry, settings, env);\n  });\n  // Begin teardown now: an immediate unmount cannot reach the scope held by this queue.\n  void previous?.dispose();\n}\n\nexport function updatePrimitiveSettings(\n  entry: PrimitiveSlot,\n  settings: PluginSettings,\n  env: PrimitiveEnv,\n): void {\n  if (!entry.primitiveScope) {\n    // No live scope: either the plugin has no primitives, or a restart is\n    // still disposing and these settings must queue behind it.\n    if (entry.primitiveRestart) restartPrimitives(entry, settings, env);\n    return;\n  }\n  const handles = entry.primitiveHandles;\n  const allInPlace =\n    // An updater receives settings, not new params; templates need fresh activation.\n    !nativeOps(entry.manifest).some((op) => hasNativeParamTemplates(op.params)) &&\n    handles.length === entry.primitiveActivations &&\n    handles.every((handle) => typeof handle.updateSettings === 'function');\n  if (allInPlace && handles.length > 0) {\n    for (const handle of handles) handle.updateSettings?.(settings);\n    return;\n  }\n  restartPrimitives(entry, settings, env);\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/releaseLedger.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Releases of exclusive page resources that have not finished yet.\n *\n * Unmounting a plugin only starts its teardown: a scope still waiting on an\n * async startup (formula copy reading its format, say) settles later. Until\n * then the resource is not free, and a successor must not start a second copy\n * of the runtime beside the one still shutting down. The ledger belongs to the\n * `PluginHost`, not to an engine, so a release outlives the engine that began\n * it (adapter swap, stop→start).\n *\n * Each release carries its own token and clears only that token when it\n * settles. A release that never settles keeps its resources busy for good:\n * there is no timeout that would pretend the old runtime is gone.\n */\nimport type { ResourceId } from './resourceClaims';\n\nexport interface PendingRelease {\n  readonly token: number;\n  readonly pluginId: string;\n  readonly resources: readonly ResourceId[];\n}\n\nexport class ReleaseLedger {\n  private nextToken = 0;\n  private readonly pending = new Map<number, PendingRelease>();\n  /** resource → waiter key → callback; one callback per key. */\n  private readonly waiters = new Map<ResourceId, Map<string, () => void>>();\n\n  /** Track `released` for the resources `pluginId` held; nothing to track without resources. */\n  record(pluginId: string, resources: readonly ResourceId[], released: Promise<unknown>): void {\n    if (resources.length === 0) return;\n    const token = ++this.nextToken;\n    this.pending.set(token, { token, pluginId, resources: [...resources] });\n    const settle = (): void => {\n      this.pending.delete(token);\n      for (const resource of resources) this.notifyIfFree(resource);\n    };\n    released.then(settle, settle);\n  }\n\n  /** The oldest unfinished release of `resource`, or null when it is free. */\n  releasing(resource: ResourceId): PendingRelease | null {\n    for (const release of this.pending.values()) {\n      if (release.resources.includes(resource)) return release;\n    }\n    return null;\n  }\n\n  /**\n   * Call `callback` once `resource` has no unfinished release. A second\n   * request under the same `key` while the first still waits is dropped.\n   */\n  whenFree(resource: ResourceId, key: string, callback: () => void): void {\n    if (!this.releasing(resource)) {\n      callback();\n      return;\n    }\n    let byKey = this.waiters.get(resource);\n    if (!byKey) {\n      byKey = new Map();\n      this.waiters.set(resource, byKey);\n    }\n    if (!byKey.has(key)) byKey.set(key, callback);\n  }\n\n  private notifyIfFree(resource: ResourceId): void {\n    if (this.releasing(resource)) return;\n    const byKey = this.waiters.get(resource);\n    if (!byKey) return;\n    this.waiters.delete(resource);\n    for (const callback of byKey.values()) callback();\n  }\n}\n"
    },

      "path": "src/features/plugins/runtime/targetedOps.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * DOM ops that address page elements (everything but `native`), and how one\n * of them writes to a matched element through the shared `DomEffectLedger`.\n */\nimport { logger } from '@/core/services/LoggerService';\n\nimport { PLUGIN_HIDDEN_CLASS } from '../constants';\nimport { attributeIssue, styleValueIssue } from '../manifest/sinkGuards';\nimport type { DomOperation, NativeOperation } from '../types';\nimport type { DomEffectLedger } from './domEffectLedger';\n\nexport type TargetedOperation = Exclude<DomOperation, NativeOperation>;\n\nexport function isTargetedOp(op: DomOperation): op is TargetedOperation {\n  return op.op !== 'native';\n}\n\n/**\n * Apply `op` to one matched element on behalf of plugin `id`. `render`\n * substitutes the plugin's current setting values into templated strings.\n * Returns false when the rendered attribute is rejected: the op then stops for\n * every remaining element too.\n */\nexport function applyOpToElement(\n  ledger: DomEffectLedger,\n  id: string,\n  el: Element,\n  op: TargetedOperation,\n  render: (value: string) => string,\n): boolean {\n  switch (op.op) {\n    case 'addClass':\n      ledger.addClass(id, el, op.className);\n      break;\n    case 'hide':\n      ledger.addClass(id, el, PLUGIN_HIDDEN_CLASS);\n      break;\n    case 'setAttribute': {\n      const value = render(op.value);\n      const issue = attributeIssue(op.name, value);\n      if (issue) {\n        logger.warn('Rendered plugin attribute rejected', { id, name: op.name, issue });\n        return false;\n      }\n      // A whole `style` write joins the per-property layers: kept in a ledger of\n      // its own, restoring it would wipe another live plugin's setStyle values.\n      if (op.name === 'style' && el instanceof HTMLElement) {\n        for (const [prop, declared, priority] of ledger.styles().parse(value)) {\n          ledger.setStyle(id, el, prop, declared, priority);\n        }\n      } else {\n        ledger.setAttribute(id, el, op.name, value);\n      }\n      break;\n    }\n    case 'setStyle':\n      if (el instanceof HTMLElement) {\n        for (const [prop, raw] of Object.entries(op.styles)) {\n          const value = render(raw);\n          const issue = styleValueIssue(value);\n          if (issue) {\n            logger.warn('Rendered plugin style rejected', { id, prop, issue });\n            continue;\n          }\n          // Literal shorthands expand; variable shorthands retain their declaration\n          // while the ledger captures every longhand they cover before writing it.\n          for (const [longhand, declared, priority] of ledger.styles().property(prop, value)) {\n            ledger.setStyle(id, el, longhand, declared, priority);\n          }\n        }\n      }\n      break;\n  }\n  return true;\n}\n"

      "path": "src/features/plugins/verbs/conversationExport/index.ts",
      "content": "import { startChatGptExportOpenListener } from '@/features/plugins/builtin/chatgptExport/openListener';\nimport { createExportEntrypoint } from '@/pages/content/export';\nimport { openPersistentExportToolbar } from '@/pages/content/export/persistentExportToolbar';\nimport { exportSiteFor } from '@/pages/content/export/sites/resolveExportSite';\n\nimport { getPrimitiveContract } from '../contracts';\nimport type { Primitive } from '../types';\n\nexport const conversationExportPrimitive: Primitive = {\n  contract: getPrimitiveContract('conversationExport')!,\n  validateParams(raw) {\n    if (\n      raw !== undefined &&\n      (raw === null || typeof raw !== 'object' || Array.isArray(raw) || Object.keys(raw).length)\n    ) {\n      return { success: false, error: [{ path: 'params', message: 'must be an empty object' }] };\n    }\n    return { success: true, data: {} };\n  },\n  activate(scope, _params, context) {\n    context.setTargetCounter(\n      () => context.doc.querySelectorAll('[data-gv-component=\"persistent-export-toolbar\"]').length,\n    );\n    const exportSite = context.adapter ? exportSiteFor(context.adapter) : null;\n    if (!exportSite) return;\n    const { entryPoints } = exportSite;\n    // Installed before the async mount: until the toolbar exists the popup hears \"no conversation\".\n    const stopOpenListener =\n      entryPoints.kind === 'toolbar' && entryPoints.opensFromPopup\n        ? scope.effect(() => {\n            const stop = startChatGptExportOpenListener(openPersistentExportToolbar);\n            // dispose() aborts first but awaits the mount before this effect: go silent at the abort.\n            scope.signal.addEventListener('abort', stop, { once: true });\n            return () => {\n              scope.signal.removeEventListener('abort', stop);\n              stop();\n            };\n          }, 'conversation-export-popup-open')\n        : null;\n    const start = createExportEntrypoint(exportSite);\n    scope.effect(\n      () =>\n        start({ signal: scope.signal }).catch((error: unknown) => {\n          // Nothing mounted, so the popup reports the exporter unreachable, not an empty page.\n          void stopOpenListener?.();\n          throw error;\n        }),\n      'conversation-export',\n    );\n  },\n};\n"

      "path": "src/features/plugins/verbs/registry.ts",
      "content": "/**\n * Primitive registry — the whitelist behind the `native` op (D9).\n *\n * Keyed by primitive NAME (not plugin id: that is the separate, first-party\n * `nativeHandlers` binding for builtin plugins, left untouched until P4).\n * Every entry is first-party code bundled in the extension; a manifest can\n * only pick one by name and pass validated parameters.\n *\n * Each `verbs/<name>/index.ts` exports its primitive and is found here with\n * `import.meta.glob`, so adding a primitive is adding its folder. Vite-only:\n * Bun scripts and the CLI read the data-only `contracts.ts` instead.\n */\nimport { PRIMITIVE_CONTRACTS } from './contracts';\nimport type { Primitive } from './types';\n\nconst INDEX_PATH = /^\\.\\/([^/]+)\\/index\\.ts$/;\n\nfunction isPrimitiveLike(value: unknown): value is Primitive<never> {\n  if (typeof value !== 'object' || value === null) return false;\n  const candidate = value as Partial<Primitive<never>>;\n  return typeof candidate.validateParams === 'function' && typeof candidate.activate === 'function';\n}\n\nexport interface DiscoveredPrimitives {\n  readonly primitives: ReadonlyMap<string, Primitive<never>>;\n  /** Folders whose `index.ts` could not be registered, by name. */\n  readonly problems: readonly string[];\n}\n\n/**\n * The primitive each `./<name>/index.ts` module exports, keyed by name. exportEntry,\n  t,\n}: {\n  siteDomain: string;\n  siteLabel: string;\n  promptEnabled: boolean;\n  onTogglePrompt: () => void;\n  promptDataTransfer: PromptDataTransferController;\n  plugins: => void;\n  };\n  t: (key: TranslationKey) => string;\n}) {\n  // Listed only where the exporter's `matches` cover the active tab (ChatGPT).\n  const exportPlugin = plugins.manifests.find((plugin) => plugin.id === CHATGPT_EXPORT_PLUGIN_ID);\n  // Likewise ChatGPT-only; the card itself stays hidden until the builtin is on.\n  const hasBridgePlugin = plugins.manifests.some(\n    (plugin) => plugin.id === CHATGPT_LOCAL_BRIDGE_PLUGIN_ID,\n  );\n  return (\n    <>\n      {hasBridgePlugin && <ChatGptBridgeCard t={t} />}\n      {exportPlugin && exportEntry && (\n        <ChatGptExportCard\n          plugin={exportPlugin}\n          enabled={exportEntry.enabled}\n          activeTabId={exportEntry.activeTabId}\n          activeUrl={plugins.activeUrl}\n          onOpened={exportEntry.onOpened}\n          t={t}\n        />\n      )}\n      {siteDomain && (\n        <Card style={{ order: -2 }} className=\"p-4\">\n          <CardContent className=\"p-0\">\n            <div className=\"group flex items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n              <div className=\"min-w-0 flex-1\">\n                <Label\n </p>\n              </div>\n              <Switch\n                id=\"prompt-manager-site-enabled\"\n                checked={promptEnabled}\n                onChange={onTogglePrompt}\n              />\n            </div>\n          </CardContent>\n        </Card>\n      )}\n      {/* The shared prompt library remains available on third-party sites. */}\n      <Card style={{ order: -2 }} exportLocalPluginJson,\n  importLocalPlugin,\n  importLocalPluginFiles,\n  removeLocalPlugin,\n} from '@/features/plugins/local/localPluginImport';\nimport {\n  type LocalPluginRecord,\n  loadLocalPluginRecords,\n  subscribeLocalPlugins,\n} from '@/features/plugins/local/localPluginStore';\nimport { validateLocalManifest } from '@/features/plugins/local/validateLocalManifest';\nimport type { ManifestIssue } from '@/features/plugins/manifest/validate';\nimport type { PluginManifest } from '@/features/plugins/types';\n\n/** One stored local plugin, re-validated the way `LocalPluginSource` reads it. */\nexport interface LocalPluginEntry {\n  readonly id: string;\n  readonly record: LocalPluginRecord;\n  /** Null when the stored manifest no longer passes this build's checks. */\n  readonly manifest: PluginManifest | null;\n  readonly issues: readonly ManifestIssue[];\n}\n\nexport function toLocalPluginEntries(\n  records: Readonly<Record<string, LocalPluginRecord>>,\n): LocalPluginEntry[] {\n  return Object.entries(records)\n    .map(([id, record]): LocalPluginEntry => {\n      const result = validateLocalManifest(record.manifest, undefined, { hostPolicy: 'defer' });\n      return result.success\n        ? { id, record, manifest: result.data.manifest, issues: [] }\n        : { id, record, manifest: null, issues: result.error };\n    })\n    .sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));\n}\n\n/** Pick → read: browser files become path + text, bounded before reading. */\nasync function readPickedFiles(\n  files: readonly File[],\n): Promise<LocalPluginFile[] | LocalPluginImportResult> {\n  const total = files.reduce((sum, file) => sum + file.size, 0);\n  if (total > MAX_LOCAL_PLUGIN_IMPORT_CHARS * 4) {\n    return {\n      ok: false,\n      issues: [{ path: 'file', message: `exceeds ${MAX_LOCAL_PLUGIN_IMPORT_CHARS} characters` }],\n    };\n  }\n  return Promise.all(\n    files.map(async (file) => ({\n      name: file.webkitRelativePath || file.name,\n      text: await file.text(),\n    })),\n  );\n}\n\nfunction downloadText(filename: string, text: string): void {\n  const blob = new Blob([text], { type: 'application/json;charset=utf-8' });\n  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n  const anchor = document.createElement('a');\n  anchor.href = url;\n  anchor.download = filename;\n  document.body.appendChild(anchor);\n  anchor.click();\n  setTimeout(() => {\n    anchor.remove();\n    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);\n  }, 0);\n}\n\n/** Local plugin list plus import / export / remove for the popup plugin page. */\nexport function useLocalPlugins() {\n  const [entries, setEntries] = useState<readonly LocalPluginEntry[]>([]);\n  const [result, setResult] = useState<LocalPluginImportResult | null>(null);\n  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);\n\n  useEffect(() => {\n    let active = true;\n    const load = (): void => {\n      void loadLocalPluginRecords().then((records) => {\n        if (active) setEntries(toLocalPluginEntries(records));\n      });\n    };\n    load();\n    const unsubscribe = subscribeLocalPlugins(load);\n    return () => {\n      active = false;\n      unsubscribe();\n    };\n  }, []);\n\n  const runImport = useCallback(\n    async (job: () => Promise<LocalPluginImportResult>): Promise<LocalPluginImportResult> => {\n      setBusy(true);\n      setResult(null);\n      let outcome: LocalPluginImportResult;\n      try {\n        outcome = await job();\n      } catch (error) {\n        outcome = {\n          ok: false,\n          issues: [\n            { path: 'file', message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) },\n          ],\n        };\n      }\n      setResult(outcome);\n      setBusy(false);\n      return outcome;\n    },\n    [],\n  );\n\n  const importFiles = useCallback(\n    (files: readonly File[]) =>\n      runImport(async () => {\n        const read = await readPickedFiles(files);\n        return Array.isArray(read) ? importLocalPluginFiles(read) : read;\n      }),\n    [runImport],\n  );\n\n  /** Pasted text is read as a single `plugin.json` with its CSS inlined. */\n  const importText = useCallback(\n    (text: string) => runImport(() => importLocalPluginFiles([{ name: 'plugin.json', text }])),\n    [runImport],\n  );\n\n  /**\n   * A manifest already read and previewed (the AI-reply flow), imported as is,\n   * and only over the install the preview was made against (`expectedInstalled`).\n   */\n  const importManifest = useCallback(\n    (raw: unknown, expectedInstalled: string | null) =>\n      runImport(() => importLocalPlugin(raw, undefined, { expectedInstalled })),\n    [runImport],\n  );\n\n  const remove = useCallback(async (id: string) => {\n    setResult(null);\n    try {\n      await removeLocalPlugin(id);\n    } catch (error) {\n      // Storage refused the read or write: nothing was removed; say so.\n      setResult({\n        ok: false,\n        issues: [{ path: id, message: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }],\n      });\n    }\n  }, []);\n\n  const exportPlugin = useCallback((entry: LocalPluginEntry) => {\n    downloadText(`${entry.id}.json`, exportLocalPluginJson(entry.record));\n  }, []);\n\n  return {\n    entries,\n    result,\n    busy,\n    importFiles,\n    importText,\n    importManifest,\n    remove,\n    exportPlugin,\n    clearResult: () => setResult(null),\n  };\n}\n\nexport type LocalPluginsController = ReturnType<typeof useLocalPlugins>;\n"
